【Draft tightens production licensing for infant supplementary foods, open for comment】A draft of the Review Guidelines for Production Licensing of Infant Supplementary Foods has been published for public comment. Gasoline Prices Hold Near $2.90 — Gasoline Prices Hold Near $2.90 US gasoline prices held near $2.90 per gallon, hovering just above their lowest level in more than three months after reversing much of their conflict-driven surge over the past quarter. Oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz continued to improve, with crude shipments topping 10 million barrels per day under US military protection, according to a US official. The UAE also restored exports to pre-war levels by relying on alternative routes, while Iran's crude shipments exceeded 40 million barrels after the US ended its naval blockade. Separately, President Donald Trump welcomed progress in negotiations following another round of indirect talks. On the data front, gasoline inventories fell by a larger-than-expected 2.333 million barrels in the week ended June 26. Elsewhere, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged oil and gas companies to cut fuel prices, a day after President Donald Trump called on retailers to lower gasoline prices.

South Korean Shares Slide to 3-Week Low — The benchmark KOSPI slipped nearly 4% to around 7,990 on Thursday, extending losses to its lowest level in three weeks, as a global selloff in AI-related semiconductor stocks pressured market heavyweights. The decline followed sharp overnight losses in US chipmakers after concerns over the sustainability of AI spending triggered a broad technology retreat, prompting investors to trim positions in South Korea's heavily weighted semiconductor sector following the market's strong first-half rally. Losses were led by Samsung Electronics (-6.7%) and SK Hynix (-8.4%), alongside SK Square (-9.3%), Hyundai Motor (-3.2%), HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (-2.9%), Doosan Enerbility (-3.2%), SK Inc. (-8.9%), and Hyundai Mobis (-3.1%). Domestic sentiment was also pressured after South Korea's annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.2% in June, the highest since December 2023, reinforcing expectations that the Bank of Korea could maintain a tighter policy stance.

【針對嬰幼兒輔食生產 新規公開徵求意見】記者7月1日瞭解到，新版《嬰幼兒輔助食品生產許可審查細則（徵求意見稿）》開始公開徵求意見，新規進一步嚴格了許可要求，提升了產品品質。新版細則徵求意見稿對嬰幼兒輔助食品的原輔料提出了更加嚴格的管控要求。聚焦原料帶入風險，要求嚴格執行新國標，禁止使用蜂蜜，防範肉毒桿菌中毒等風險。對主要原料供應商開展現場稽核，對可能出現的摻雜使假物質進行必要的檢測。徵求意見稿，要求生產企業建立原輔料供應商稽核制度與採購驗收管理制度：對大米、小米、小麥、果蔬、畜禽、水產、乳和乳製品、維生素及微量元素等主要原輔料供應商或生產商進行現場質量安全稽核；另外在原料入庫前要查驗原料的全專案檢驗報告；畜禽應來自自建或自控的規模化集中養殖的養殖場，嚴禁使用從散戶採購的畜禽來源類原料。（央視）

【影石創新劉靖康：沒有任何一家企業可單靠價格戰實現長期壟斷或盈利】影石創新創始人、董事長劉靖康近日在公司2025年年度股東會上表示，目前國內的智慧影像市場格局，以大疆和影石創新兩家公司為主，這“並非一個理性市場”。其認為，價格戰是一場很難證偽的競爭，沒有任何一家企業可以依靠單純的價格戰實現長期壟斷或盈利，特別是消費電子行業並不能依靠價格戰讓產業合理發展下去。“面對目前智慧影像市場的競爭，影石的理念仍然是依靠對客戶需求的前瞻性洞察、提前佈局和研發投入來構建壁壘，而非短期價格競爭”。針對公司對AI演算法的投入，其坦言：“在影像技術領域找到一個百億級的事物，是我的目標；未來商業模式中，影石創新軟體付費和儲存服務的佔比可能提高。”

【UBS trims oil-price forecasts as Strait of Hormuz supplies rise】Rising energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz have prompted UBS to lower its oil-price forecasts. UBS now expects Brent to average $84/bbl this year, down $9/bbl from its prior view, and has cut its 2027 Brent forecast to $75/bbl from $85. The bank cites reduced geopolitical risk and a rapid supply rebound that drove prices lower than expected. UBS sees a modest H2 rebound to around $80/bbl as Gulf floating storage normalizes and demand recovers, but says the path to normalization may be bumpy and risk premia could remain elevated. Inventory restocking should support prices through end‑2027, though the required rebuild is smaller than its earlier 1 billion‑barrel estimate.

Heating Oil Prices Consolidate — US heating oil prices traded around $3.20 per gallon, consolidating near their lowest levels since the Iran war after retracing much of their conflict-driven surge over the previous three months. Oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz continued to recover, with crude flows exceeding 10 million barrels per day under US military protection, according to a US official. The UAE also restored oil exports to pre-war levels through alternative routes, while Iran's crude exports surpassed 40 million barrels after the US lifted its naval blockade. At the same time, President Donald Trump praised progress in negotiations following a round of indirect talks. On the data front, distillate stockpiles, which include diesel and heating oil, rose by 2.483 million barrels in the last week of June, compared with expectations for a 0.7 million-barrel decline. Elsewhere, UK diesel prices posted a record monthly decline in June, further signaling easing pressure across distillate fuel markets.

【亞洲股市遭遇十六年來最大半年外資流出】在人工智慧（AI）推動股市強勁上漲後，外國投資者在2026年上半年以至少16年來最快速度拋售亞洲股票。倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）的資料顯示，今年前六個月，海外投資者從韓國、中國臺灣、印度、印尼、泰國、越南和菲律賓股市累計淨流出1373.6億美元，為2010年有記錄以來最大規模的半年度資金流出。其中韓國和中國臺灣首當其衝，分別遭遇708億美元和296億美元外資淨流出。
【7月4日美國獨立日假期美股市場何時休市？】今年，美國獨立日恰逢週六。美國股票和債券市場將於週五休市。債券市場也將於週四提前休市。具體來看，週五美股因美國獨⽴紀念⽇假期休市一日。芝商所旗下貴金屬、美國原油、外匯、股指期貨合約交易提前於北京時間4日01:00結束。洲際交易所旗下布倫特原油期貨合約交易提前於北京時間04日01:30結束。

【China’s national elderly-care subsidy goes live on JD; 50% off home-care services, 800 yuan/mo cap】From July 1 China’s national elderly-care consumption subsidy is available on JD.com, with the first e-commerce redemption executed in Beijing. The Ministry of Civil Affairs and Ministry of Finance will subsidize services for moderately disabled and more severely disabled elderly across home care, institutional care, respite and day-care; the JD rollout covers home-care services. Eligible seniors on the JD app receive a 50% reduction on purchases of high-frequency in-home services — assisted bathing, domestic help, hospital escort, rehab/physiotherapy and short-term care — with a maximum subsidy of 800 yuan per person per month.

【隨著霍爾木茲海峽供應量增加，瑞銀下調油價預期】途經霍爾木茲海峽的能源運輸量不斷增加，促使瑞銀下調其2026-2027年油價預期。瑞銀目前預計，今年布倫特原油均價為每桶84美元，較早前預期下調每桶9美元。該行還將2027年油價預期從每桶85美元下調至75美元。瑞銀表示：“地緣政治風險降低以及供應量的快速反彈，導致價格下跌幅度超出我們的預期。“該行預計，隨著海灣地區的浮動儲備恢復正常且需求回升，今年下半年油價將小幅反彈至每桶80美元。瑞銀還認為風險溢價會更高，因為恢復正常的道路可能依然崎嶇。瑞銀表示：“補充庫存的需求應會在到2027年底前繼續支撐價格，但所需的庫存重建規模小於我們此前預期的10億桶。”

【《智慧網聯汽車 組合駕駛輔助系統安全要求》強制性國家標準正式釋出】2026年6月27日，工業和資訊化部組織制定並歸口的《智慧網聯汽車 組合駕駛輔助系統安全要求》（GB47955—2026）強制性國家標準由國家市場監督管理總局、國家標準化管理委員會批准釋出，擬於2027年1月1日起正式實施。《智慧網聯汽車 組合駕駛輔助系統安全要求》的釋出和實施，為組合駕駛輔助系統明確統一的安全規範，對提升智慧網聯汽車安全水平、保障產業健康可持續發展具有重要意義。下一步，工業和資訊化部將認真做好標準的宣貫實施，加強智慧網聯汽車產品准入管理，進一步壓實企業安全主體責任，保障組合駕駛輔助系統安全合規應用；同時，加快釋出實施自動駕駛系統等其他強制性國家標準，推動構建完善的智慧網聯汽車標準測試和監管體系，加速自動駕駛技術產業化程序，引領我國智慧網聯汽車產業高質量發展。
瑞銀下調油價預測，因霍爾木茲海峽輸油量提升。

【South Korean stocks plunge over 6% as AI compute oversupply fears hit chipmakers】South Korean equities tumbled after Meta’s plan to sell computing capacity raised concerns of AI compute oversupply. Peru Inflation Accelerates Slightly to 4.0% — The annual inflation rate in Peru’s capital, Lima, accelerated slightly to 4.01% in June 2026 from 3.9% in the previous month. Still, it remained above the central bank's 1%-3% target range. Prices accelerated primarily for food & non-alcoholic beverages (3.32% vs 2.88% in May), furnishings & household equipment (3.00% vs 2.81%), restaurants & hotels (4.15% vs 3.98%), and housing & utilities (1.21% vs 1.04%), boosted by adjusted residential electricity rates. Meanwhile, inflation moderated for transportation (14.63% vs 15.10%) and recreation & culture (2.01% vs 2.07%), while prices declined for alcoholic beverages & tobacco (-0.45% vs 0.05%). On a monthly basis, the CPI rose 0.23%, rebounding from a 0.1% fall in May, due to higher prices for food, furnishings, and restaurants.

Dollar Holds Steady Ahead of Jobs Report — The dollar index was little changed at around 101.4 on Thursday after experiencing heightened volatility in the previous session, as investors cautiously awaited the June jobs report for fresh insights into labor market conditions and greater clarity on the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook. Data released on Wednesday showed private-sector hiring in the US slowed more than expected last month. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh also said inflation expectations had eased over the past month, signaling there was no urgency to raise interest rates. However, he reiterated the central bank’s commitment to restoring price stability. Markets continue to price in more than a 60% chance of a Fed rate hike in September. The dollar also remained resilient despite rising oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and signs of progress in indirect US-Iran talks, which pushed oil prices lower and eased inflation concerns.

Japanese Shares Fall on Tech-Led Selloff — The Nikkei 225 Index fell 2% to around 69,000 on Thursday, snapping a three-day winning streak as it tracked a tech-driven selloff on Wall Street overnight amid lingering concerns over the sustainability of the AI-fueled rally. Chip- and AI-related stocks led the decline, with steep losses from Kioxia Holdings (-11.4%), Taiyo Yuden (-4.3%), Tokyo Electron (-6.2%), Advantest (-6.7%), and Fujikura (-6.6%). In contrast, financial and consumer shares mostly advanced, including Mitsubishi UFJ (1.9%), Mizuho Financial (2.4%), and Toyota Motor (3.6%). Japanese equities also came under pressure despite increased oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz and signs of progress in indirect US-Iran talks. Meanwhile, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation expectations had eased over the past month, signaling there was no urgency to raise interest rates.

【沃什說服了特朗普先不降息？專訪歐洲經濟學家米霍夫】“沃什曾提出一套論點，闡述為何降息並非壞事，反而有利；然而在首次會議上，他似乎又在這一立場上有所退縮。在我看來，這是一個非常重要的訊號。”歐洲工商管理學院（INSEAD）前院長、現任勞辛經濟與商業講席教授伊利亞·米霍夫表示。米霍夫對記者表示：“我的推測是，沃爾什成功說服了特朗普，讓他相信通脹是其競選（中期選舉）面臨的最大敵人——畢竟美國前總統拜登的敗選很大程度上就是因為通脹問題。”

【Shenghong Technology: mid-term high-end product supply to remain relatively tight】Shenghong Technology said on July 1 in an investor-relations record that mid-term supply of high-end products will remain relatively tight. High-end PCB capacity expansion has long lead times and high equipment and process barriers, so new expansion projects are unlikely to deliver meaningful capacity in the short term. Downstream leading customers are prioritizing supply-chain stability, product quality and on-time delivery.
【勝宏科技：高階產品的供給仍將處於相對緊張的狀態】勝宏科技7月1日在投資者關係活動記錄表中指出，從中期來看，高階產品的供給仍將處於相對緊張的狀態。高階PCB產能擴張週期長、裝置與工藝壁壘高，新增擴產專案短期難以形成有效產能供給。現階段下游頭部客戶以確保供應鏈穩定、保障產品品質與交付為核心訴求。

【日產CEO堅稱與雷諾的合作從未如此牢固】繼日產汽車公司失去一名董事會成員後，其合作伙伴、最大股東雷諾集團撤回支援，這家日本車企隨即發出一個明確訊號：一切安好。 在紐約接受採訪時，日產執行長伊萬·埃斯皮諾薩（Ivan Espinosa）淡化了雷諾上週拒絕對有影響力的外部董事 Motoo Nagai重新任命投票一事的重要性。 儘管這一舉動導致 Motoo Nagai失去了自2019年起一直擔任的董事會席位，但埃斯皮諾薩表示，此事並不意味著日產與雷諾關係再度緊張。 “很多言論是在股權交叉結構變更時說的，比如‘他們要離婚了，彼此恨得要命’，”埃斯皮諾薩說，“但現實是，我們現在合作比以往任何時候都更加緊密。”
【匯通集團與京石公司簽署路企戰略合作備忘錄】據匯通集團訊息，7月1日，河北京石高速公路開發有限公司副總經理卞照躍帶隊到訪匯通集團，雙方實地觀摩物流園區產業鏈運營，開展深度座談研討，並正式簽署戰略合作備忘錄，搭建長效協同合作平臺。下一步，雙方將加快推進大資料平臺搭建、保通保暢、優惠政策落地等工作，持續完善配套服務，以路企協同新模式賦能區域產業高質量發展。

【全國鐵路實行第三季度列車執行圖 深圳鐵路運能升級】從7月1日起，全國鐵路實行第三季度列車執行圖，較調圖前增加106列。本次調圖後，深圳鐵路迎來全域運能升級，廣深港高鐵、城際通勤、跨區域幹線三大維度同步提質增效。此次調圖，深港跨境通行能力再度升級。香港西九龍直達內地站點新增廣州北、義烏、福清西3個站點，總數增至113個。廣深港高鐵高峰每小時開行30列，平均兩分鐘一班，跨境出行真正實現公交化通勤。同時，兩趟長途列車始發站調整至福田站，實現跨境通勤與跨省長途出行雙向提質。
【中國銀河證券：年內豬價或有所反彈表現】中國銀河證券研報稱，關於2026年豬價走勢，中國銀河證券認為年度均價或呈現同比下行走勢，受冬季疫病影響程度的變化，年內豬價或有所反彈表現。中國銀河證券建議積極關注成本管控領先、資金面相對健康、估值合理的優秀豬企。
百信國際控股有限公司在香港暫停交易。
日產執行長堅稱，與雷諾的聯盟從未如此牢固。

【中信證券：液冷產業進入訂單與業績兌現階段 建議把握三條主線機會】中信證券研報稱，液冷產業正從主題預期進入訂單與業績兌現階段，關注具備產能彈性、客戶認證和核心部件能力的供應鏈公司。代工鏈短期業績彈性大，GB200/GB300量產導致臺系及國際龍頭產能緊張，大陸企業憑藉精密加工和組裝承接外溢訂單。自主品牌供應鏈長期成長性最強，憑藉認證資產和客戶介面卡位CSP、ODM及國產GPU生態，當前處於樣機和小批次驗證階段。橫向新品類提供差異化機會，配電系統、光模組液冷等新品價值量較低但客戶廣、易切入。建議沿“代工鏈業績彈性、自主品牌認證突破、橫向新品類放量”三條主線把握機會。

【韓國股市重挫6% AI擔憂導致晶片製造商股票下跌】韓國股市大跌，Meta Platform Inc.計劃出售算力，引發投資者對AI產能過剩的質疑，導致晶片製造商類股遭拋售。Kospi指數一度下跌6.5%，三星電子和SK海力士的跌幅均至少達到7%。由於Kospi期貨大幅下跌，交易所暫時中止了程式化賣出操作。美國同類股票美光科技和閃迪的股價均下跌超過10%。這一走勢可能會加劇投資者對晶片股漲勢可持續性的擔憂。此前，全球人工智慧建設的蓬勃發展推動晶片股飆升。韓國市場權重股處於供應鏈的核心位置，迄今為止一直受益於市場對先進硬體的持續需求。然而，韓國股市近期的劇烈波動凸顯出，一旦人們對這種繁榮的可持續性產生質疑，市場情緒就會迅速轉變。

【RAC: UK diesel posts largest monthly drop on record】UK diesel prices fell sharply in June, the latest sign the inflation shock tied to the Iran war is rapidly fading, the RAC said. Average diesel dropped nearly 17p to 167p per litre, the biggest single-month fall since records began in 2000. Petrol fell 8p to 151p per litre, the seventh-largest monthly decline on record. The fuel price falls are likely to offset some of the inflationary impact from a 13% household energy bill rise that took effect yesterday. Markets now expect the UK inflation peak to be well below the BoE's April projection; traders have sharply reduced rate-hike bets and no longer fully price a hike this year.
【江西樂安河發生2026年第2號洪水】從水利部瞭解到，受降雨影響，江西鄱陽湖水系樂安河香屯水文站7月1日23時漲至38.01米，超警戒0.01米，依據主要江河洪水編號規定，此次洪水編號為“樂安河2026年第2號洪水”。

【英矽智慧：與武田製藥達成價值最高 6 億美元的 AI 賦能藥物發現戰略合作】英矽智慧公告，本集團已與武田製藥（「武田製藥」）訂立一項戰略合作協議。雙方將依託英矽智慧自主研發的全流程 Pharma.AI 人工智慧藥物研發平臺，針對武田製藥選定的疾病治療領域聯合開展候選藥物研發，聚焦高潛力治療靶點，開發具備臨床差異化優勢的候選藥物（「本次合作」）。本次合作項下，英矽智慧負責主導人工智慧驅動的藥物發現環節，篩選滿足預設科學標準與早期開發要求的候選分子；武田製藥將依託其成熟的全球化藥物開發實力，推進對應候選藥物的臨床試驗驗證工作。依據協議約定條款，英矽智慧可收取約 6000 萬美元專案啟動金及近期里程碑款項；同時有權收取臨床前、臨床、商業化及銷售階段對應的各期里程碑付款，整筆合作交易總金額最高可達約 6 億美元，另可在合作產品實現商業化後，按產品銷售額收取分級特許權使用費。武田製藥將獨家享有本次合作產出創新療法在全球範圍內的開發、生產及商業化權益。
【全球最大的黃金ETF SPDR Gold Trust持倉較前日增加0.28噸】截至2026年07月01日，全球最大的黃金ETF SPDR Gold Trust持倉量為1005.36噸，較前一個交易日增加0.28噸。
碧桂園控股：截至2026年5月31日，發行人合併範圍內較前次統計時點（2026年4月30日）涉及新增標的金額5,000萬元以上的未決訴訟、仲裁案件20宗，標的金額合計約52.18億元。

【中證協公佈2026年第四批IPO現場檢查名單 11家為科創板IPO】中證協於今日公佈關於2026年第四批首發企業現場檢查抽查名單，共抽中21家IPO。其中，11家IPO來自科創板，分別是世和基因、博睿康、普生醫療、卓鐳鐳射、好達電子、夏禾科技、物奇微、金連線、中電防務、匯禾醫療、東方晶源；8家IPO來自創業板，分別是光遠新材、耐德股份、超力電器、延長中科、百靈生物、瑞高新材、永康防務、億鈳氣體；2家IPO來自滬市主機板IPO，分別為勝華波、康佰家。值得注意的是，本次被抽中現場檢查的21家IPO均於6月受理。
【日經指數下跌2.2%】日經225指數擴大跌幅，最新下跌2.2%，報68953.80點。鎧俠控股股價下跌9%，軟銀集團股價下跌3%。
【英格蘭地區遭遇有系統觀測以來最熱6月】英國氣象局7月1日表示，今年6月，英格蘭地區經歷了英國有系統觀測以來最熱的6月。6月26日諾福克郡林伍德最高氣溫達到37.7攝氏度，創下英國有系統觀測以來6月最高氣溫紀錄。（央視新聞）

【South Korea inflation stays elevated, reinforcing Bank of Korea hawkish stance】South Korea June CPI rose 3.2% YoY, the fastest pace since Dec 2023 and in line with economists' forecasts. Core inflation excluding volatile food and energy held at 2.5%, signalling persistent underlying price pressures. The print reinforces expectations that the Bank of Korea will remain hawkish ahead of its July 16 policy meeting; policymakers cite inflation, strong growth, a weaker won and surging house prices as increasingly pointing to the need to tighten monetary policy.

【韓國Kospi指數大跌 晶片股跟隨美股走低】韓國Kospi指數一度下跌6%，晶片製造商股價跟隨美國同行下跌，投資者正在評估美聯儲主席凱文·沃什關於通脹的最新言論。SK海力士、三星電子和三星電機對指數拖累最大。韓國小型股Kosdaq指數下跌幅度一度高達4.6%。MSCI亞太指數一度下跌1.1%。

【China successfully launches Haiyang-2E ocean-observation satellite】At 07:46 Beijing time on July 2, 2026, China launched the Haiyang-2E ocean-observation satellite from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on a Long March 4B rocket; the satellite reached its planned orbit and the mission was declared successful. The launch was the Long March family’s 654th flight.
【我國成功發射海洋二號E衛星】北京時間2026年7月2日7時46分，我國在酒泉衛星發射中心使用長征四號乙運載火箭，成功將海洋二號E衛星發射升空，衛星順利進入預定軌道，發射任務取得圓滿成功。此次任務是長征系列運載火箭的第654次飛行。

【中信證券：功率器件二輪漲價趨勢確立 AI電源開啟長期增量空間】中信證券指出，功率器件板塊正迎來二輪漲價週期確認與AI電源需求爆發的雙重催化。中短期，根據各公司公告，國內外功率器件廠商將陸續啟動第二輪漲價，本輪上行週期進一步明確；中長期來看，預計AI電源對功率器件拉動會持續強化，HVDC/SST趨勢下長期增量空間將逐步開啟。預計本輪漲價趨勢有望延續至2027年，相關廠商有望開啟新一輪收入快速成長同時盈利能力顯著修復，看好功率器件板塊整體上行機遇。

【百心安-B：國家藥監局批准BIOHEART生物可吸收藥物洗脫支架註冊】百心安-B(02185)釋出公告，於2029年6月29日，由本公司自主研發的Bioheart®生物可吸收藥物洗脫支架(BRS)，已獲中華人民共和國國家藥品監督管理局(國家藥監局)批准，用於治療因原生冠狀動脈病變所致的缺血性心臟病患者，以改善冠狀動脈管腔直徑。Bioheart®BRS關鍵性試驗的詳細結果已發表於《JACC: Cardiovascular Interventions》(2025年第18卷第1號)。

【石四藥集團：美索巴莫片(0.5g)獲藥品生產註冊批件】石四藥集團(02005)釋出公告，本集團是首家國內企業取得中國國家藥品監督管理局(國家藥監局)有關美索巴莫片(0.5g)的藥品生產註冊批件，屬於化學藥品第3類，視同透過一致性評價。美索巴莫片是一種肌肉鬆弛藥，主要用於關節肌肉扭傷、腰肌勞損、坐骨神經痛等病症。

【中金：機構間REITs供給年底有望實現翻倍擴容】中金公司表示，展望後市，中金認為機構間REITs供給年底有望實現翻倍擴容。市場或將呈現三大發展主線：外資加速佈局盤活不動產、儲架式序列發行與存量擴募走向常態化、各類首單底層資產持續落地。隨著底層運營資料不斷積累、監管引導深化，產品架構設計將進一步向權益本源收斂。長遠來看，在監管體系逐步完備的支撐下，機構間REITs將成為盤活不動產存量資產、服務實體經濟的長效權益融資載體。
【科華資料山河灣谷智算中心揭牌投運】據科華資料訊息，7月1日，由科華資料自主投資、設計及建設的山河灣谷智算中心正式揭牌投運。在座談會交流及戰略簽約環節，科華資料與北京移動朝陽分公司正式簽署戰略合作協議。雙方將以山河灣谷智算中心為合作基點，在算力網路共建、智算場景應用、行業解決方案等領域開展深度合作。
美國股指期貨下跌；納斯達克100指數期貨下跌0.4%。

【中信建投：金剛石高導熱材料替代空間廣闊 產業鏈相關標的具備長期投資價值】中信建投指出，金剛石散熱材料商業化程序持續提速，AI伺服器、消費電子兩大賽道均出現規模化落地產品。算力側，神達、AMD金剛石散熱AI伺服器、曙光數創兆瓦級金剛石銅浸沒液冷整機櫃已批次商用，Akash金剛石冷卻GPU伺服器斬獲大額訂單；消費端微星遊戲顯示卡、聯想AI輕薄本、高階PC水冷頭均匯入金剛石複合散熱方案。英特爾新一代伺服器處理器也有望配套金剛石導熱材料。伴隨AI高算力硬體持續迭代，金剛石高導熱材料替代空間廣闊，產業鏈相關標的具備長期投資價值。

【銀河證券：瓦楞紙價格持續上行 龍頭企業集中停機收縮供給】銀河證券研報指出，2026年6月，造紙行業延續“停機+提價”組合拳，箱板瓦楞紙淡季逆勢大漲。6月初玖龍紙業十大基地全線提漲50—100元/噸，中旬21家企業陸續跟漲50—200元/噸，提價範圍和幅度為近三年淡季罕見。6月第二週箱板紙、瓦楞紙噸價環比分別上漲35元和48元，瓦楞原紙價格較4月低點累計上漲約11%。文化紙與白卡紙方面，晨鳴、太陽、APP等紙廠於6月20日起對銅版紙、雙膠紙及白卡紙系列同步上調200元/噸。龍頭企業協同大規模停機檢修收縮供給，玖龍、山鷹、理文、榮成等各大基地於5月底至6月執行密集停機計劃，涉及瓦楞、箱板紙等多紙種，進一步改善供需關係，為紙價上漲提供底部支撐。

【江西樂安河發生2026年第2號洪水】受降雨影響，江西鄱陽湖水系樂安河香屯水文站（江西上饒市）7月1日23時漲至38.01米，超警戒0.01米，依據主要江河洪水編號規定，此次洪水編號為“樂安河2026年第2號洪水”。6月30日，國家防總副總指揮、水利部部長李國英召開專題會商，對鄱陽湖水系洪水防禦作出安排部署。水利部密切關注樂安河等河流洪水發展變化，向江西省水利廳發出“一省一單”，提醒做好水庫安全度汛、中小河流洪水、山洪災害防禦和城市內澇防範等工作。江西省水利廳維持洪水防禦四級應急響應，滾動會商研判風險，派出專家組赴上饒等地協助指導洪水防禦工作。

Silver Stabilizes on Warsh Remarks — Silver steadied above $59 an ounce on Thursday after hitting seven-month lows in recent sessions, as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation expectations had eased over the past month, suggesting there was no urgency to raise interest rates. However, he reiterated the central bank’s commitment to restoring price stability. Data released on Wednesday also showed private-sector hiring in the US slowed more than expected last month, while investors now await the nonfarm payrolls report later today for fresh insights into labor market conditions and the Fed’s policy outlook. Markets continue to price in more than a 60% chance of a Fed rate hike in September. Silver also drew support from rising oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and signs of progress in indirect US-Iran talks, which pushed oil prices lower and eased inflation concerns.

Internationally, transit through the Strait of Hormuz has eased crude supply disruption and pushed WTI toward about $70/bbl, easing upward pressure on global inflation; however Kevin Warsh's policy stance continues to intermittently influence US monetary expectations. Domestically, the A‑share market is entering interim‑results season; stronger July–August results are expected to support indices, CICC says prior volatility and rapid style rotation may be waning, and interim earnings should progressively become the main investment focus.

【中信建投：看好相關創新藥及製藥企業的醫保準入與商保增量空間】中信建投研報指出，2026年6月29日，國家醫保局公示透過2026年基本醫保目錄及商保創新藥目錄調整初步形式審查的藥品名單及相關資訊。本次形式審查呈現三大特徵：一是申報品種數量進一步提高，共收到申報材料818份、涉及674個通用名，較2025年增加100份材料、41個通用名；二是形式審查透過率大幅提升，除預申報品種外初步形式審查總體透過率達92%，較去年提高8個百分點；三是申報品種以新藥為主，以目錄外條件1（五年內獲批新通用名藥品）申報的數量達343個。疊加今年首次引入的“預申報”機制，本次結果充分體現了醫保目錄調整對創新藥的持續傾斜，看好相關創新藥及製藥企業的醫保準入與商保增量空間。

【公募基金展望下半年：投資邏輯正由估值驅動轉向業績驅動】回顧2026年上半年，市場行情幾經切換，從年初受益於漲價邏輯的有色資源板塊率先走強，到中東衝突擾動市場風險偏好，資金在不確定性中選擇了高景氣度的科技主線，推動以光通訊、儲存晶片為代表的AI硬體節節攀升，科技成長股演繹出極致的結構性行情。展望2026年下半年，多家公募基金公司對投資主線與市場風格進行了展望。機構普遍認為，AI仍將是市場最重要的投資主線，但隨著產業進入業績兌現階段，投資邏輯正由估值驅動轉向業績驅動，AI投資機會也有望向稀土、電力等產業鏈上下游持續擴散。與此同時，市場經歷上半年的極致結構性行情後，波動或有所加大，風格再平衡也值得關注。

【華泰證券：高股息板塊底倉配置價值仍具吸引力】華泰證券研報稱，6月以來市場風險偏好整體維持積極，資金延續向成長方向聚集，半導體、光模組、AI算力鏈等仍是市場核心主線，高股息板塊整體相對跑輸。但月內成長內部波動明顯加大，紅利底倉的避險價值階段性迴歸。展望7月，在成長擁擠度高企、估值處於年內相對高位、海外通脹超預期與美聯儲加息預期升溫的背景下，高股息板塊底倉配置價值仍具吸引力，建議重點關注具備防禦屬性的穩定型紅利（銀行、電力、公用事業、交運等）。

【紐約電價飆升 高溫天氣給美國電網帶來沉重負擔】紐約至弗吉尼亞州的電價正在飆升，因為持續高溫威脅著美國電網，可能影響獨立日假期的出行安排。 預計從週四開始，東海岸大片地區氣溫將超過100華氏度（38攝氏度），並持續到週末，其中最強烈的高溫將集中在大西洋中部各州。這股熱浪將加劇電力系統的負荷壓力，並進一步增加需求壓力，部分原因在於資料中心的激增。 目前電價已開始上漲。當地時間週三下午3時25分，紐約市的電價已突破每兆瓦時1100美元，並預計在晚間繼續攀升。在美國最大電網運營商PJM互聯公司（PJM Interconnection LLC）的系統中，電價已躍升至自一月份歷史性暴風雪襲擊東海岸以來的最高水平。 週三，一條旨在將魁北克水電輸送到紐約的輸電線路剛剛完成建設，但已停運，進一步加重了該州電網的壓力。魁北克水電公司一名發言人表示，工作人員正努力於當晚儘快恢復運營，這條查普蘭-哈德遜電力快線可滿足紐約約20%的電力需求。

【購車群體陷入“提車即過時”迭代焦慮 新能源汽車新品紅利週期大幅壓縮】上個月剛入手的新能源新車，短短一個月便可能漸漸“不香了”，當下的購車群體普遍陷入“提車即過時”的迭代焦慮。燃油車時代，一款主力車型可穩定熱銷數年才完成一次換代。如今，這一市場格局正在被打破，新能源汽車的新品紅利週期被大幅壓縮。據記者觀察，新車依靠上市營銷造勢、首發專屬權益短期衝量，交付曲線迅速衝高。可隨著同價位競品密集上新、同質化車型扎堆入場，疊加消費者觀望情緒升溫，銷量隨即快速回落。一輪輪衝高、回落迴圈往復，形成典型的脈衝式銷量走勢。受訪業內專家指出，新能源車銷量脈衝式波動，表象是月度交付起伏劇烈、爆款生命週期急劇縮短，核心則是技術迭代超速、行業同質化內卷加劇、消費心態迴歸理性三重矛盾交織疊加的結果。（證券時報）

【吉峰科技：向特定物件發行股票申請符合發行條件】吉峰科技公告，公司於2026年7月1日收到深圳證券交易所上市稽核中心出具的《關於吉峰三農科技服務股份有限公司申請向特定物件發行股票的稽核中心意見告知函》。深交所發行上市稽核機構對公司向特定物件發行股票的申請檔案進行了稽核，認為公司符合發行條件、上市條件和資訊披露要求，後續深交所將按規定報中國證券監督管理委員會履行相關注冊程式。公司本次向特定物件發行股票事項尚需中國證監會同意註冊後方可實施，最終能否獲得中國證監會作出同意註冊的決定及其時間尚存在不確定性。

【道明證券：日本支撐日元的手段已所剩無幾】道明證券稱，日元走軟繼續反映利差巨大這一因素，當局目前可能已用盡支撐日元的工具。“日本已無計可施，其短期政策工具已基本用盡，” Jayati Bharadwaj等策略師在研報中寫道。“軟性檢查、實際干預，甚至加息都未能對日元產生持續影響。”日元倉位越來越看跌，越來越擁擠，“作為美債的最大外國持有者，如果日本為了干預而拋售資產，美債收益率可能會面臨一定上行壓力，但日本一直在增持短期品種。”這應該會減輕長端的壓力，使拋售僅為暫時現象，令利率維持在近期區間內。
【必和必拓申請重啟智利銅礦，擬投資15億美元延長礦山壽命20年】7月2日訊息，必和必拓（BHP）已向智利提交環境影響研究，申請重啟位於該國北部的Cerro Colorado銅礦專案，計劃投資15億美元，將礦山運營壽命再延長20年。該礦因環境許可證到期，於2023年停止運營，目前獲准維持臨時停產狀態至2028年，等待審批完成。

【股權承銷馬太效應凸顯，上半年五大券商投行分得80%以上募資額】Wind資料顯示，按上市日口徑統計，上半年全市場股權融資（含IPO、增發、可轉債、可交換債等）總規模為4556.04億元，較2025年同期下降40%。具體來看，兩大核心引擎——IPO與增發的表現截然不同。受益於科創產業融資需求爆發，上半年IPO專案數量與融資規模齊升，分別為71家、705.74億元，同比增長約89%、39%。反觀增發市場，儘管專案數量同比增長約47%至113起，但融資總額為3658.3億元，同比下滑約48%。從各大券商的股權承銷排名來看，馬太效應凸顯。“三中”（中信證券、中信建投證券、中金公司）及國泰海通證券、華泰證券雄踞前五，合計分得80%以上的募資額。其中，中信證券以1478.38億元的股權承銷規模穩居首位；中信建投證券、國泰海通證券則分列第二、第三，股權承銷規模均為646億元左右；華泰證券、中金公司則依次排名第四、第五，股權承銷規模分別超過500億元、400億元。另外，中銀證券、申萬宏源證券的股權承銷規模均超100億元，招商證券、國金證券、浙商證券、國投證券、國元證券的股權承銷規模也都超過50億元。

【日元持續走弱導致日本上半年企業破產數量創2022年以來新高】日元貶值致使日本上半年企業破產案例創下2022年同期以來峰值，凸顯日元暴跌帶來的經濟代價不斷加劇。東京商工調查所週三釋出報告顯示，1至6月共有45家企業因日元貶值宣告破產，同比增幅超30%。該機構自2022年起專項統計將日元疲軟列為破產誘因的企業，本次資料為統計以來最高值。資料反映出，吸納日本絕大部分就業人口的中小微企業愈發難以承受日元長期貶值的衝擊。即便出口企業從中受益，日元弱勢仍給日本整體經濟蒙上陰影。
麥格理給予安克創新A股跑贏大盤的初始評級。

【下半年“一九分化”行情或難持續 機構認為市場或偏向於均值迴歸】今年上半年，A股市場演繹了堪稱“一九分化”的極致行情。Wind資料顯示，截至7月1日，科創50以60.17%的年內漲幅遙遙領先，創業板指緊隨其後上漲33.02%，兩者分別代表硬科技和成長股的最高彈性。相比之下，滬深300僅漲7.11%，代表大盤藍籌的上證50反而下跌1.51%，成為唯一收跌的主要指數。國金資管權益投資部投資副總監、投資經理周櫟偉認為，當前市場割裂的核心邏輯在於，景氣板塊（如電子）貢獻了較大的利潤增長，股價表現較好，但部分高估值品種出現了泡沫，同時部分弱勢板塊中的優質公司表現不佳。對於科技行情的持續性，周櫟偉卻比較謹慎。他認為，過於極端的行情或很難持續。“下半年，市場或偏向於均值迴歸，迴歸至增長超預期且估值跌幅超預期的板塊和公司。”周櫟偉表示，金融、創新藥、CXO、快遞、出口等行業中被錯殺的部分優秀公司，在均值迴歸的過程中或會存在利潤和估值雙擊的機會。
RBNZ appoints Angus McGregor as Assistant Governor responsible for financial stability.
紐西蘭儲備銀行：任命安格斯·麥格雷戈為負責金融穩定事務的助理行長。
【中國3D大模型人工智慧初創公司哇嘶嗒科技完成1.5億美元融資】根據公司新聞稿，哇嘶嗒科技(Vast，亦稱為Tripo AI)近期完成了A3輪融資，籌資逾1.5億美元。吉利資本、復星創富和策源資本參與了本輪融資。現有投資者渶策資本和元生資本也參與了本輪融資。
【SpaceX新人工智慧裝置將使用高通晶片？馬斯克否認】當地時間7月1日，有訊息稱，SpaceX已開發出一款外觀類似手機的AI裝置原型，採用高通驍龍晶片。這款裝置採用纖薄設計，比iPhone更薄，執行SpaceX自有作業系統，並整合了SpaceX旗下xAI的人工智慧技術。馬斯克隨後回應稱，“完全錯誤”。
武田製藥與英矽智慧達成AI藥物發現合作，價值最高達6億美元。

【歷史性熱浪來襲 美國將迎“炙烤版”獨立日】當地時間週三，創紀錄高溫從美國中西部蔓延至東部地區，數千萬民眾處於高溫預警之下。預計這輪熱浪將持續到7月4日獨立日假期長週末，屆時美國民眾將慶祝建國250週年。酷熱預計將使上述大部分割槽域體感溫度升至100至115華氏度（37.8至46.1攝氏度），不僅增加高風險人群罹患熱相關疾病的風險，還可能令電網不堪重負。週三上午極端高溫開始侵襲紐約市。紐約市長馬姆達尼(Zohran Mamdani)在新聞釋出會上表示，該市已開放數百個避暑中心，並部署十餘輛配備水、電解質飲料、防曬霜和餐食的“降溫服務車”，為有需要的市民提供幫助。西歐近期也遭遇創紀錄熱浪。科學家表示，如果沒有人為導致的氣候變化，這類事件“幾乎不可能”發生。科學家經過多年的研究證實，溫室氣體排放正導致全球熱浪變得更頻繁，也更猛烈。
【以防長稱以軍將在黎巴嫩等地無限期駐留】以色列國防部長卡茨當地時間7月1日在講話中說，為保護以色列居民和社群免遭威脅，以色列國防軍將在位於黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦加沙地帶和敘利亞的所謂“安全區”內“無限期駐留”。另據黎巴嫩方面訊息，以軍在黎以邊境和黎巴嫩南部設立多個檢查站，並繼續在黎巴嫩南部進行軍事行動。

Brent Extends Decline on Rising Supply — Brent fell toward $71 per barrel on Thursday, reaching its lowest level since late February as oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz continued to increase and investors welcomed signs of progress in indirect US-Iran talks. A US official said crude flows through the strategic waterway exceeded 10 million barrels per day with support from the American military. The UAE’s oil exports have also returned to pre-war levels through workarounds. Meanwhile, Iranian oil exports jumped above 40 million barrels following the lifting of a US naval blockade, while record Russian shipments contributed to a significant buildup in seaborne inventories. At the same time, President Donald Trump praised the progress in negotiations, and Qatar said the next round of talks would be held as soon as possible. However, Tehran continued to insist on retaining maritime administrative control over the strait.
【烏克蘭防空部門：烏克蘭首都基輔遭導彈和無人機襲擊】烏克蘭防空部門在社交媒體上發帖稱，週三晚間以來，首都基輔遭到彈道導彈和無人機襲擊。市長Vitali Klitschko在社交媒體上表示，多個居民區發生火災，應急隊伍趕赴現場。烏克蘭哈爾科夫和波爾塔瓦地區也遭到襲擊，當地政府稱正在核實情況。

【券商資管管理的公募基金規模逼近萬億關口】由券商資管管理的公募基金規模，已逼近萬億關口。Wind資料顯示，今年上半年，9家券商資管共新成立42只新發基金（不同份額合併統計，下同），其中24只為權益類產品。在A股結構性牛市繼續演繹的背景下，券商資管也在積極突破過往以固收策略為主的能力圈，積極延展權益類資產配置。與此同時，券商資管的私募存量規模也連續多月回升，4月底創下2023年以來新高。在上述42只產品中，除了有24只權益類產品，還有固收產品10只、FOF（基金中的基金）產品6只、REITs（不動產投資信託基金）產品2只。細分來看，在24只權益類產品中，多數產品屬於主動管理的混合型基金，共有17只；6只股票型基金中有5只為指數型基金，其中又有4只產品屬於被動指數型基金；另外，還有1只佈局港股的QDII（合格境內機構投資者）基金。截至7月1日，由券商資管管理的公募產品數量已達541只，總規模接近9700億元，成為37.5萬億元公募市場中一股無法忽視的力量。

【Heat dome and floods hit multiple regions in Canada】A destructive heat dome is sweeping much of Canada, driving prolonged extreme temperatures and placing millions under heat warnings. Environment and Climate Change Canada has issued alerts for Ontario, Quebec and other areas; daytime highs and humidex readings are running well above seasonal averages. Separately, heavy rain earlier this week triggered severe flooding in Manitoba's Parkland region, and the western Manitoba city of Dauphin declared a state of emergency on the 1st.

Oil Extends Decline on Rising Supply — Crude oil fell to around $68 per barrel on Thursday, reaching its lowest level since late February as oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz continued to increase and investors welcomed signs of progress in indirect US-Iran talks. A US official said crude flows through the strategic waterway exceeded 10 million barrels per day with support from the American military. The UAE’s oil exports have also returned to pre-war levels through workarounds. Meanwhile, Iranian oil exports jumped above 40 million barrels following the lifting of a US naval blockade, while record Russian shipments contributed to a significant buildup in seaborne inventories. At the same time, President Donald Trump praised the progress in negotiations, and Qatar said the next round of talks would be held as soon as possible. However, Tehran continued to insist on retaining maritime administrative control over the strait.
【市場解讀：通脹回升 使韓國央行維持7月加息路徑不變】彭博經濟研究稱，6月份通脹率進一步上升，超過韓國央行2%的目標水平，表明高油價正傳導至消費者價格。該通脹資料加大了央行收緊貨幣政策的必要性，避免通脹形成長期固化態勢。預計韓國央行將於7月16日啟動緊縮週期，首次加息25個基點。隨後在10月再加息25個基點，並於明年進行兩次更多加息，到2027年上半年將政策利率從目前的2.5%上調至3.5%。

【國巨電容漲價 機構預計更多MLCC原廠將跟進】7月1日，市場傳聞被動元件大廠國巨向客戶端通知價格調整，自當日開始調漲全系列電容產品價格，包括鉭電、MLCC（片式多層陶瓷電容器）、鋁電、固態鋁電、薄膜電容、超級電容等，涉及的產品覆蓋國巨約50%營收，且漲價物件首次納入直接客戶（EMS/OEM）。記者致電東莞市超翔電子有限公司、深圳市河鋒鑫科技有限公司等多家國巨代理商進行求證，相關代理商均表示，國巨全系列電容產品漲價屬實，且本次調漲的物件從代理商擴充套件至直接客戶，等同現貨價、合約價同步調漲。中信證券認為，在國巨帶動下，會有更多MLCC原廠落地漲價動作，今年7月前後原廠密集漲價潮將漸次落地。該機構預測，本輪MLCC漲價週期有望延續超過一年，幅度可能翻倍甚至更多。華創證券電子組聯席首席分析師岳陽也表示，AI伺服器正在把MLCC從傳統被動元件，重新定價為算力基礎設施中的關鍵瓶頸物料。（上證報）

【加拿大多地遭遇極端高溫和洪澇災害 】極具破壞性的“熱穹頂”現象目前正席捲加拿大大部分地區，引發持續極端高溫天氣，導致數百萬民眾處於高溫預警之下。與此同時，加部分地區遭遇暴雨和嚴重洪澇災害。據加拿大媒體1日報道，安大略省大部分地區炎熱潮溼，是此次熱浪受災最嚴重的省份之一。該省西南部日間氣溫持續走高、夜間無法有效降溫，東部也正遭受曠日持久的熱浪襲擊。加拿大環境與氣候變化部已向安大略省、魁北克省等地釋出高溫預警，敦促居民注意保持水分攝入，避免在高溫巔峰時段進行戶外活動。上述地區的日間最高氣溫和溼度指數已遠超往年同期平均水平。

【國巨電容漲價 機構預計更多MLCC原廠將跟進】7月1日，市場傳聞被動元件大廠國巨向客戶端通知價格調整，自當日開始調漲全系列電容產品價格，包括鉭電、MLCC（片式多層陶瓷電容器）、鋁電、固態鋁電、薄膜電容、超級電容等，涉及的產品覆蓋國巨約50%營收，且漲價物件首次納入直接客戶（EMS/OEM）。記者致電東莞市超翔電子有限公司、深圳市河鋒鑫科技有限公司等多家國巨代理商進行求證，相關代理商均表示，國巨全系列電容產品漲價屬實，且本次調漲的物件從代理商擴充套件至直接客戶，等同現貨價、合約價同步調漲。（上證報）

【Macquarie: Likely USD/JPY intervention level around 165】Macquarie expects Japanese authorities may be preparing for FX intervention but are likely to wait until USD/JPY trades near 165. The firm says any intervention would probably be delayed until after today’s US nonfarm payrolls: a weak NFP could create optimal conditions to maximize impact, while intervening beforehand and then seeing a strong NFP-driven dollar rally would risk “wasting bullets.”

【IPO業務“半年考”：創業板、科創板受理數量翻倍增長】6月30日受理53家，前一日受理45家——熟悉的IPO受理潮回來了。伴隨新一輪科技革命和產業變革加速演進，資本市場正進一步深化改革以適應創新發展趨勢。根據證券時報記者統計，今年上半年，共有242家IPO企業獲得受理，同比增長37%。從結構變化來看，“雙創板”即創業板、科創板，受理數量均實現翻倍增長，高科技企業陸續湧現。其中，為新興產業和未來產業增設的創業板第四套上市標準，已有8家IPO企業正式採用。另外，北交所受理數量仍然佔比最大，但同比減少；滬深主機板則保持小幅增長，受理節奏整體穩定。
索尼集團遊戲子公司索尼互動娛樂官方宣佈，PlayStation遊戲機新遊戲光碟版的生產將於2028年1月結束，將來只會以可下載版本的形式出售。數字媒體的需求遠遠超過實體CD，這一決定是基於客戶使用模式和市場環境的變化而做出的。
【科技主題表現突出 約七成權益類保險資管產品上半年實現正回報】2026年上半年，科技板塊表現強勢，帶動A股市場走強。受此推動，約七成權益類保險資管產品實現正投資回報。但在結構性行情演繹下，權益類保險資管產品投資回報呈現分化態勢，科技主題產品表現亮眼，而紅利類主題產品表現相對黯淡。（上海證券報）
Gavekal Dragonomics分析師表示，電動重卡的日益普及可能會使中國未來幾年的柴油消費量每年減少約2%，這將有助於推動中國期待已久的石油需求峰值提前到來，同時降低經濟受全球能源價格波動的影響。
Local officials said a high-rise apartment building in Kyiv caught fire after a Russian strike.
【美國正與AI企業商討新模型釋出的自願性標準】英國《金融時報》援引訊息人士的話報導，美國政府正與多家人工智慧(AI)公司進行深入磋商，以制定新模型釋出的自願性標準，最快可能在下週宣佈。
烏克蘭官員稱，俄羅斯襲擊後，烏克蘭基輔一棟高層公寓樓起火。

【Xianfeng Jingke: process development for lithography-machine precision parts R&D project complete】On July 1 at an investor event, Xianfeng Jingke disclosed it initiated an internal 2025 R&D project to develop precision components for semiconductor lithography equipment; process development is complete and dimensional verification of trial parts is underway. The company said it will use employee share ownership and equity incentives at an appropriate time to retain and align key managers and R&D staff with shareholders.

【Financial Times: White House accelerating plan for voluntary AI model-release standards】The Financial Times reports the White House is negotiating with AI firms to create voluntary standards for new model releases, after U.S. interventions in deployments by Anthropic and OpenAI. People familiar with the talks say the standards could be published as early as next week, setting baselines for models with advanced internet capabilities and establishing release timelines to streamline future rollouts. The initiative implements President Trump’s AI executive order from last month; stakeholders are seeking clarity on how the government will regulate the technology. Officials expect the U.S. AI Standards and Innovation Center and the NSA to play key roles in drafting and overseeing the standards. Sources add U.S. officials will specify which entities may access advanced models domestically and abroad, a step that could form the basis for a global framework including U.S. allies.

【韓國6月通脹率加速升至30個月新高】韓國6月份整體通脹率加速升至30個月新高，連續第二個月突破3%，遠高於該國央行2%的目標。韓國高企的通脹，料將為該國央行在本月晚些時候的議息會議上收緊貨幣政策提供更充分的理由。韓國統計廳(Ministry of Data and Statistics)週四表示，6月份基準消費者價格指數(CPI)同比上漲3.2%，為2023年12月以來的最快增速；5月份的漲幅為3.1%。這一最新讀數與媒體調查的七位經濟學家預測的中位數完全相符。從環比看，6月份消費者價格上漲0.1%，也與調查結果相符。5月份消費者價格環比漲幅為0.5%。剔除波動較大的食品和能源價格的核心CPI在6月份同比上漲2.5%，漲幅與上月持平。韓國統計廳資料顯示，石油產品價格漲幅居前，6月份汽油和柴油價格同比分別大幅上漲23%和34%。資料表明，儘管美伊停火協議幫助緩解了石油資源豐富的中東地區緊張局勢，從而使能源價格壓力有所緩解，但原材料成本的累積上漲和韓圓走弱正繼續向整個經濟傳導。
【先鋒精科：光刻機精密零部件研發專案已完成工藝開發】7月1日，先鋒精科在釋出的投資者關係活動中披露，公司於2025年進行了“半導體光刻機裝置精密零部件開發”研發專案內部立項，目前工藝開發完成，試驗件尺寸加工驗證中。同時，公司表示會在適當時間透過員工持股、股權激勵等方式對關鍵管理人員和研發人員進行激勵，實現核心團隊與公司及股東利益的深度繫結。

【A股IPO保薦半年盤點：三大券商領跑 中小投行借北交所突圍】2026年上半年，A股IPO保薦市場格局發生了一些新變化。Choice資料顯示：以正式掛牌上市為口徑，上半年共有71家公司登陸A股，較去年同期的51家增長39.22%；募資淨額合計639.64億元，較去年同期的334.46億元增長91.25%。在市場整體復甦的背景下，國泰海通、中金公司、中信證券強勢領跑，而東吳證券、國金證券等中小券商則憑藉深耕北交所業務實現差異化突圍。
晨星（中國）基金研究中心總監孫珩注意到，目前公募行業在產品佈局上已明顯分層：頭部機構搭建全產業鏈科技投研團隊，寬基、細分ETF、均衡成長全覆蓋；中型機構選擇性深耕AI、半導體單一細分賽道，打造特色產品線；小型機構集中資源押注高景氣小盤科技品種，以極致彈性博取短期超額收益，三者在研究深度、產品豐富度、持倉集中度、收益波動上已形成了清晰分化的局面。（中證報）

South Korea Inflation at 2 ½-Year High — South Korea’s annual inflation rate increased to 3.2% in June 2026 from 3.1% in the previous month, matching market expectations and marking the fastest rise since December 2023. Prices accelerated mainly for food and non-alcoholic beverages (2% vs 1.6% in May), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (0.5% vs 0.3%), and recreation and culture (5.4% vs 5%). Inflation also remained elevated for transport (11.1% vs 11.6%).
【委內瑞拉地震9名中國公民遇難】據中國駐委內瑞拉大使館當地時間7月1日確認，截至當天18時（北京時間7月2日6時），共有9名中國公民在委內瑞拉6月24日發生的地震中遇難。
【國泰海通：中國股市新一輪上升視窗期開啟 重點看好主線科技、製造】國泰海通釋出研報稱，不確定下降，增長預期上修與增量入市共振，中國股市在未來將開啟新一輪上升視窗期。該行認為，短暫“陣雨”後中國市場三季度會有不錯的表現，有望走出新高。科技板塊從流動性、景氣與估值維度看邏輯依舊堅實，仍是市場主線。重點看好科技、製造以及券商/銀行，部分傳統板塊也有修復。

【國泰海通：重點關注機器人整機廠及機器人核心零部件供應商】國泰海通釋出研報稱，重點關注機器人整機廠及機器人核心零部件供應商。軟銀宣佈啟動自主品牌機器人規模化量產，並計劃推動旗下機器人公司Roze赴美上市，並擬斥資約54億美元收購ABB機器人業務，加快完善機器人產業佈局。此外，銀河通用釋出全球首個人形機器人通用小腦GPT基礎模型AstraBrain-WBC 0.5並開源相關成果；智元機器人釋出具身智慧數採2.0技術體系，推動具身智慧訓練與場景驗證體系進一步完善。

【大金融引領 A股全市場4300多隻個股上漲 機構：建議聚焦有業績支撐的“真成長”】7月首個交易日，全市場超過4300只個股上漲。大金融板塊全天強勢，證券、保險漲幅居前；養殖板塊集體上漲，新希望、傲農生物漲停；醫藥板塊午後拉昇，海南海藥走出7天5板；兆易創新、新易盛等科技權重股則陷入調整。大同證券研報分析稱，短期市場或面臨三重因素博弈：一是外部流動性擾動，美聯儲加息預期仍在高位，美股科技股波動對A股情緒形成傳導；二是半年報視窗臨近，市場定價邏輯將從“景氣預期”轉向“景氣確認”，有真實訂單和盈利高增的硬科技方向有望持續獲得溢價；三是兩融餘額站上3萬億元后，市場對槓桿資金穩定性的關注度上升。總體來看：短期科技結構性行情有望延續但波動加大，內部分化成常態；中長期科技仍是主線，應聚焦有業績支撐的“真成長”。（上海證券報）
【高盛預估：世界盃或將為美國6月就業報告新增4萬個崗位】高盛表示，受世界盃拉動，週四即將公佈的6月非農就業資料或將好於市場預期。根據道瓊斯對受訪經濟學家的調查共識，非農就業人數預計將增加11.5萬人，較5月份17.2萬人的強勁增速有所放緩。但高盛表示，來自小企業薪資服務公司Homebase的私人資料顯示，“美麗足球”至少對招聘產生了一定的溫和影響，上個月貢獻了約4萬個就業崗位。

【資料顯示：俄羅斯6月柴油和輕柴油海運出口較前月減少39%】市場訊息人士和倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）的資料顯示，俄羅斯6月柴油和輕柴油海運出口量驟降，較前月大減39%至180萬噸左右，較上年同期的335萬噸下降46%，原因是一波波無人機攻擊導致國內主要煉油廠被迫停產。根據貿易商估計和路透計算，俄羅斯最大柴油出口港普里莫爾斯克的超低硫柴油出貨量較5月減少一半以上，僅62.3萬噸。俄羅斯當局尚未就禁止柴油出口作出決定，但貿易商表示，鑑於部分主要煉油廠的計劃外檢修持續時間較長，且國內需求強勁，7月超低硫柴油（ULSD）出口可能降至最低水平甚至“近零”。
Kyiv mayor said the city continues to repel drone and ballistic-missile attacks.
基輔市長：烏克蘭基輔市繼續抵禦無人機與彈道導彈襲擊。
【預測市場：Kalshi交易員認為，隨著6月能源價格下跌，美國通脹已在5月觸頂】隨著美國與伊朗關係緩和導致石油和天然氣價格下跌，預測市場的交易員們現在認為通脹已經見頂。預測市場平臺Kalshi上的投機者認為，今年美國總體通脹率將超過4.2%（即5月份CPI同比漲幅）的可能性僅為28%。下一份衡量6月份通脹水平的CPI報告，將由美國勞工統計局（BLS）於7月14日釋出。

【韓國通脹持續高企，支撐韓國央行偏鷹政策立場】韓國6月居民消費通脹升至2023年12月以來最高增速，符合經濟學家預期，進一步強化市場預判：央行將持續緊盯潛在物價上行壓力。韓國統計廳週四公佈資料顯示，6月居民消費價格指數同比上漲3.2%，5月漲幅為3.1%；媒體調查的預期中值同樣為3.2%。剔除波動較大的食品與能源價格後的核心通脹持平於2.5%，說明底層物價上漲壓力仍存韌性。該通脹資料進一步鞏固韓國央行在7月16日貨幣政策會議前日趨強硬的政策傾向。政策制定官員表示，居高不下的通脹、經濟韌性增長、韓元走弱以及房價暴漲，多重因素都愈發傾向收緊貨幣政策。韓國央行行長申鉉松多次警示，半導體出口繁榮正逐步傳導至整體消費、薪資與投資領域，加劇通脹長期固化的風險。央行最新貨幣政策會議紀要顯示，兩名委員此前已投票支援立刻加息，當前理事會成員討論的核心已從“是否加息”轉向“何時加息”。
【蘋果規劃2027上半年推出新款iPad Pro與MacBook Pro機型】據知情人士透露，蘋果正在開發新一代 iPad Pro，以及搭載 M7 晶片的全新入門款 MacBook Pro，兩款產品均計劃 2027年春季釋出。這意味著，iPad Pro 將從此前秋季釋出的週期，調整至春季上市。此舉可以平滑蘋果全年財報收益節奏，將部分新品從年末假日消費季分流到春季、返校採購季。
【烏克蘭首都基輔傳出爆炸聲】記者獲悉，當地時間7月1日，烏克蘭首都基輔市傳出多次爆炸聲。基輔市市長稱，俄軍在向基輔發射導彈。目前，俄羅斯方面對此暫無回應。（央視）

【7月2日隔夜要聞一覽】
1、美國貿易代表賈米森·格里爾1日發表宣告說，美國決定不續簽與加拿大和墨西哥的貿易協定，而是選擇對該協定進行年度審查。
2、伊朗外交部副部長、伊方技術談判代表團團長加里巴巴迪表示，美方違反諒解備忘錄承諾，將建立監督機制審查違規行為。

【科技主題表現突出 約七成權益類保險資管產品上半年實現正回報】2026年上半年，科技板塊表現強勢，帶動A股市場走強。受此推動，約七成權益類保險資管產品實現正投資回報。但在結構性行情演繹下，權益類保險資管產品投資回報呈現分化態勢，科技主題產品表現亮眼，而紅利類主題產品表現相對黯淡。Wind資料顯示，2026年上半年，在有年化回報資料的約180只權益類保險資管產品中，實現正投資回報的超過120只，佔比約七成。從年化回報排行榜來看，科技主題產品明顯跑贏其他型別。（上證報）

【“紅底股”大幅擴容 硬科技重塑港股市場生態】2026年上半年，港股市場呈現鮮明的“冰火兩重天”格局：新股發行熱度空前，AI大模型、半導體、高階製造等領域的科創企業批次登陸港交所，持續為市場注入新鮮血液。二級市場上，大模型、儲存晶片、光通訊、PCB等賽道牛股輩出，百元“紅底股”陣營大幅擴容；傳統網際網路、消費電子等板塊則持續走弱，萬億市值俱樂部迎來洗牌。港股市場冰火交織的背後，是第四次科技革命浪潮下，中國經濟結構轉型、新質生產力加速發展，與資金偏好轉移形成共振，推動港股加速“新陳代謝”，市場生態與估值體系迎來系統性重塑。（上證報）

【超越“科技抱團”敘事 資本市場包容性需要多元定價】下半年的首個交易日，A股迎來“畫風突變”式的開門紅。全市場超過4300只個股上漲，此前抱團狂飆的“小登”科技股出現獲利回吐，而沉寂許久的“老登”資產全線爆發，大有站上估值修復起點之勢。“抱團”“小登”“老登”……這些都是今年A股新興的高頻詞，清晰折射出上半年冷熱不均、高度分化的市場生態：一邊是AI產業鏈的活躍，一邊是多數行業和個股的沉寂；指數看起來不弱，投資者體感卻差異懸殊。但“矽基”經濟顯然不是中國經濟的全部。對於一個擁有14億多人口、完整產業體系和龐大內需市場的大國，值得投資的更不會只有算力、晶片和光模組。無論“小登”“老登”，從產業視角看本應共榮，在資本市場更能共存。對理性務實的投資者而言，只要能超越預期，都是“好登”。讓不同型別、不同發展階段、不同風險水平的企業獲得與其基本面相匹配的定價，讓不同偏好的投資者都能找到適合自己的資產，這需要資本市場多方合力，構建更多元的定價體系與更包容的“審美”視角。（上證報）

【美伊舉行間接會談 美稱進展順利 伊指責美違反備忘錄承諾】有訊息人士透露，美國和伊朗7月1日在多哈舉行間接會談，由卡達和巴基斯坦擔任斡旋方。會談討論內容包括解凍伊朗被凍結資產以及確保霍爾木茲海峽海上安全等議題。對於此次會談，美國總統特朗普和副總統萬斯均稱“進展順利”。伊方技術談判代表團團長加里巴巴迪則表示，伊方在會談中提出，美方違反諒解備忘錄的承諾，將組建監督小組審查美方違規行為。

【同業股權掃貨熱度升溫 中小銀行改革成重要推手】近日，寧夏銀行受讓寧夏黃河農商銀行7.635%股權事項獲批准，成為後者第三大股東。這並非孤例。今年以來，廈門國際銀行增持廊坊銀行、中信銀行競得雲南紅塔銀行股權等案例接連落地。業內人士表示，從入股異地銀行實現跨區展業、主發起行增持村鎮銀行，到戰略投資同業股權，銀行參股同業情形日趨多元，此舉已成為銀行主動最佳化資產配置、完善區域戰略佈局、拓展業務版圖的重要手段。（中證報）

【“翻倍基”全面爆發 卡位科技投資各顯神通 在2026年上半年的科技單邊行情下，公募基金業績迎來大面積爆發。Wind資料顯示，上半年回報率超100%的“翻倍基”數量達240只以上（僅統計主份額，下同），創歷年之最。此前，在上半年出現“翻倍基”的年份還是2015年和2007年。 結合持倉來看，算力、半導體等AI硬體板塊是上半年公募機構投資的制勝關鍵。業內人士表示，公募機構普遍前瞻佈局AI、半導體等高景氣細分賽道，從均衡泛權益轉向賽道精細化卡位，依靠細分產業研究打造業績亮點，形成多點開花的投研佈局轉變。（中證報）
【一級半市場成超額“富礦”公募定增策略浮盈分化】一級半市場正在成為公募機構重要的超額收益來源。 從公募機構定增的“半年考”成績來看，不少基金公司浮盈頗豐，傳統定增大戶、頭部基金公司在定增方面收益率居前，還有一些中型機構憑藉“少而精”定增策略賺得盆滿缽滿，但也有少數機構旗下產品被個股表現所拖累，定增專案處於浮虧狀態。（中證報）

【基金業績“貧富差距”收窄 公募錨定產業盈利主線】伴隨下半年投資視窗開啟，公募基金圍繞K型分化收斂、投資策略再平衡的討論持續升溫。 Wind最新資料顯示，上半年全市場業績翻倍基金數量突破200只，同期半年淨值跌幅超20%的基金數量同樣破百隻，兩端收益差距較為懸殊。業績榜單靠前產品大多側重佈局AI全產業鏈，年內最高主動權益基金收益率達到183.67%，算力、應用端、AI硬體為主要持倉方向；重倉傳統消費賽道的主動權益基金同期最大虧損為34.48%。行情的分化，拉大了基金經理的業績差距，也讓基民持倉體驗冷熱不均。 雖然估值低位行業已經出現估值回升和基本面復甦的跡象，但業內人士判斷，K型分化的收斂大機率是長期且緩慢的過程，部分基金公司預期賽道強弱存在邊際緩和空間，但結構性分化現象仍有長期存續的可能。（證券時報）

【基金把脈下半年投資風向：AI主題轉向業績驅動 市場或迎風格再平衡】回顧2026年上半年，市場行情幾經切換，從年初受益於漲價邏輯的有色資源板塊率先走強，到中東衝突擾動市場風險偏好，資金在不確定性中選擇了高景氣度的科技主線，推動以光通訊、儲存晶片為代表的AI硬體節節攀升，科技成長股演繹出極致的結構性行情。 展望2026年下半年，多家公募基金公司對投資主線與市場風格進行了展望。機構普遍認為，AI仍將是市場最重要的投資主線，但隨著產業進入業績兌現階段，投資邏輯正由估值驅動轉向業績驅動，AI投資機會也有望向稀土、電力等產業鏈上下游持續擴散。與此同時，市場經歷上半年的極致結構性行情後，波動或有所加大，風格再平衡也值得關注。（證券時報）

【ETF格局生變：“千億基”沒了 多元時代來臨】上半年，ETF市場延續結構性發展態勢。科技主題ETF繼續保持較強吸金能力，通訊裝置、半導體、科創晶片等細分賽道成為規模增長主力，資金配置繼續向景氣產業聚集。從資料上看，ETF市場整體仍保持擴容勢頭。截至6月底，全市場ETF數量達到1595只，再創歷史新高。 與此同時，市場規模格局出現新變化，去年快速擴張的滬深300等寬基ETF規模有所回落，公募ETF“千億俱樂部”暫時清零。不過，產品型別不斷豐富，市場正由少數寬基產品主導逐步邁向更加多元的發展階段。（證券時報）

【創新藥賽道回暖 相關ETF獲資金積極佈局】近期，在政策最佳化、產業催化以及資金迴流等多重因素推動下，創新藥板塊表現活躍。機構認為，隨著行業基本面持續改善、創新成果加快兌現，創新藥板塊有望迎來新一輪估值修復機會。 資料顯示，截至6月30日，多隻創新藥相關ETF近一週獲得資金淨流入。其中，廣發中證創新藥產業ETF近一週獲得5.26億元資金增持，廣發中證香港創新藥ETF、國泰上證科創板創新藥ETF均獲得超4億元資金淨流入，易方達中證創新藥產業ETF、匯添富國證港股通創新藥ETF等產品也均獲得資金加倉。 與此同時，板塊賺錢效應持續顯現。截至7月1日，國泰上證科創板創新藥ETF近一週上漲16.24%，匯添富上證科創板創新藥ETF上漲15.96%，富國中證滬港深創新藥產業ETF等產品漲幅均超過10%。（證券時報）

【Iran parliament speaker says IAEA inspectors not allowed into destroyed or damaged nuclear sites】Iran released a video on the evening of July 1 in which Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said reports that IAEA inspectors would be allowed into bombed nuclear facilities are incorrect. He said Iran’s parliament passed a law, approved by the Supreme National Security Council (SNSC), prohibiting any entry into destroyed or damaged nuclear sites. Ghalibaf said the IAEA may only access two locations — the Bushehr nuclear power plant and the Tehran research reactor — and Iran will not grant privileges beyond the SNSC’s authorized scope.

【伊朗議會議長：不允許核查人員進入受損核設施】當地時間7月1日晚，伊朗方面釋出了伊朗伊斯蘭議會議長卡利巴夫的一段談話影片。卡利巴夫稱，關於“允許國際原子能機構的核查人員進入被炸燬核設施”的說法是錯誤的。他表示，伊朗伊斯蘭議會透過了一項法律，該法律得到最高國家安全委員會的批准，規定不得以任何方式允許進入被炸燬或受損的核設施。卡利巴夫強調，國際原子能機構只能進入兩個地點：布什爾核電站和德黑蘭核研究反應堆。伊朗方面不提供任何超出最高國家安全委員會設定許可權範圍的特權。（央視新聞）
【卡達外交部：圍繞美伊諒解備忘錄取得積極進展】卡達外交部發言人稱，卡達和巴基斯坦調解人週三在多哈分別結束了與美國和伊朗談判代表的會談。在瑞士峰會成果的基礎上，就與伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄相關的問題取得了“積極進展”各方同意在“未來一段時間”繼續磋商。下一輪會談將在伊朗前最高領袖葬禮結束後儘快安排。

【Korean banks expand trading teams ahead of near-24-hour KRW trading】Major Korean banks are expanding FX trading staff and bolstering Seoul–London coverage ahead of a near-24-hour KRW FX trading regime launching July 6. Woori Bank has seconded eight staff to its London office covering FX, derivatives and bond trading. Hana Bank added traders in Seoul and implemented three-shift rotations for round-the-clock coverage. Shinhan Bank and KB Kookmin Bank have also increased headcount and upgraded trading systems. The moves are aimed at improving KRW liquidity and supporting internationalization of Korea’s financial markets.

【必和必拓申請15億美元智利銅礦重啟專案審批】必和必拓集團已提交一份環境影響評估報告，計劃斥資15億美元重啟旗下位於智利北部的科羅拉多山銅礦，目標將礦山開採年限再延長20年。該方案擬重新運營這座地處塔拉帕卡大區的礦山；該礦此前因環境許可到期，已於2023年停產。必和必拓表示，該專案將創造約1500個施工崗位，以及3000餘個長期運營崗位。

【Apple plans new iPad Pro and redesigned entry-level MacBook Pro for 2027】US tech reporter Mark Gurman reported Apple is planning upgraded iPad Pro models and a redesigned entry-level MacBook Pro for 2027. Apple is testing four iPad Pro models targeted for spring 2027; sizes will remain 11-inch and 13-inch. Upgrades are focused on internal changes, including faster chips. Apple has tested vapor-chamber heat-spread (VC liquid cooling) for iPads to improve sustained performance and reduce overheating. Separately, Apple plans a redesigned entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro, codename K104, due in 1H 2027; its design will align with an upcoming high-end touch-screen MacBook expected late this year to early next year.

Uruguay Holds Key Interest Rate — The Central Bank of Uruguay kept its policy rate unchanged at 5.75% at its June 2026 meeting, as its projections continue to place inflation on a path toward convergence with the 4.5% target over the monetary policy horizon. Inflation expectations also remained aligned with the central bank’s objective. Annual inflation rose to 3.77% in May, driven by higher administered prices, particularly energy, reflecting the impact of global supply shocks. Core inflation edged up to 3.6%, though policymakers noted no significant second-round effects. Easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East reduced global financial volatility and pressure on energy prices. Labor market and income indicators remained resilient, while economic activity continued to expand. The central bank said inflation is likely to rise in the short term, but the balance of risks remains broadly balanced over the policy horizon. Future policy decisions will depend on incoming inflation data and its underlying dynamics.

【全新iPad Pro、重新設計入門款MacBook Pro正在籌備中】蘋果公司正計劃於明年推出升級款iPad Pro系列與全新改款入門MacBook Pro，恰逢iPhone問世20週年，該公司同期還規劃了多款重磅新品。蘋果正在測試四款內部硬體升級的全新iPad Pro機型，搭載效能更強的晶片；同時打造外觀重新設計的入門MacBook Pro。蘋果計劃2027年密集釋出多款硬體新品，首發首款M7處理器，同步推出第二代iPhone Air以及入門款iPhone。

【象牙海岸阿比讓強降雨已致59人死亡】象牙海岸新聞部長、政府發言人阿馬杜·庫利巴利1日表示，今年雨季以來，科經濟首都阿比讓的連續強降雨引發山體滑坡、塌方和內澇等自然災害，已造成59人死亡。

【7月2日美股成交額前20：Meta籌劃進軍雲端計算，股價應聲大漲】週三美股成交額第3名Meta Platforms收高8.81%，成交276.61億美元。據報道，Meta正籌劃推出一項全新的雲基礎設施業務，計劃對外出售其過剩的AI計算能力和模型訪問許可權，此舉將直接挑戰亞馬遜AWS、微軟Azure和谷歌雲在雲端計算領域的主導地位。據Meta執行長扎克伯格在年度股東大會上透露，進軍雲端計算市場“絕對在考慮範圍內”。他表示幾乎每週都有外部公司前來詢問能否以溢價購買Meta的算力，若未來出現算力過剩，對外出租將是自然的選擇。分析認為，Meta此舉有望開闢新的收入來源，緩解市場對公司鉅額AI投資回報的擔憂。

US Stocks Slide as Chipmakers Sink — US equity indices closed lower on Wednesday as investors reassessed the sustainability of the AI-driven rally. The S&P 500 fell 0.2%, while the Nasdaq 100 dropped 1.5%, pressured by a sharp selloff in semiconductor stocks. Major chipmakers led the decline as concerns persisted that AI-related investments may have become overstretched. Micron Technology plunged 10.6%, while AMD lost 6.9% and Intel dropped 9%. In contrast, Meta surged 8.8% after announcing plans to develop a cloud business aimed at monetizing excess AI computing capacity. Other hyperscalers within the Magnificent Seven extended their rebound, with Microsoft rising 3%, Amazon gaining 1.4%, and Alphabet up 1.1%. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones closed near flat as economically sensitive sectors outperformed after data showed US manufacturing activity expanded for a sixth straight month while input cost pressures eased. Fed Chairman Warsh noted that inflation risks are decreasing, limiting the need for an urgent hawkish response.

【沃什希望美聯儲減少發聲 華爾街擔憂市場波動恐加劇】凱文·沃什執掌美聯儲僅數週時間，但分析師已開始擔心，他希望央行減少發聲的關鍵承諾可能會加劇市場波動。對華爾街許多人而言，美聯儲的指引有助於他們為央行可能採取的行動做準備。美聯儲減少發聲可能增加市場對利率政策路徑的不確定性，隨著新資料促使交易員重新評估前景，這不僅可能加劇國債市場的波動，還會推高美債的溢價，因為投資者在購買這些債券時會要求更高的回報補償。道明證券策略師Gennadiy Goldberg和Molly Brooks週三在研報中寫道：“市場對前瞻性指引的依賴總體上降低了不確定性，並導致交易倉位更加集中。取消前瞻性指引應該會導致市場波動加劇，同時推高期限溢價。”

Citing a decline in US credibility, Gulf states are recalibrating ties. After a US‑Iran memorandum, Iran and Oman held a first meeting on management of the Strait of Hormuz. Follow‑up talks are planned between Oman and Qatar, Iran and Saudi Arabia, and Qatar and Saudi Arabia to outline post‑conflict coexistence. Discussions focus on Strait of Hormuz navigation arrangements and potential economic incentives Gulf states might offer Iran in exchange for security concessions. These talks are concurrent with but independent from US‑Iran negotiations.

【ECB's Stournaras says further tightening may not be needed after June hike】ECB Governing Council member Stournaras said an unexpected fall in energy prices and slowing euro-area inflation may mean the bank does not need to tighten policy further after a June rate increase. Euro-area CPI eased to 2.8% YoY, below forecasts, which he called a clear downside surprise. He said attention should shift to how firms pass through energy-cost changes and how AI-driven investment could alter price dynamics. "I don't expect any change in July unless things deteriorate significantly," he said, and he favors keeping policy unchanged for a period. The ECB has already raised rates to 2.25%. Stournaras cited Gulf central bankers' assessments that recent shocks caused limited damage to energy infrastructure and said Iran may release more crude, countering prior market tightness assumptions. He warned energy-price rises transmit quickly to consumer prices while declines pass through more slowly, reflecting limited competition in parts of Europe, and noted AI investment could weigh on electronics prices, notably imports from Korea and Taiwan.

Uruguay Jobless Rate Rises Slightly in May — Uruguay’s unemployment rate edged up to 7.6% in May 2026 from 7.5% in April, pointing to a broadly stable labor market. By region, the jobless rate stood at 7.7% in Montevideo and 7.6% in the country’s interior. By gender, unemployment was lower among men at 6.8%, compared with 8.5% for women. Younger workers continued to face the highest unemployment, with the rate reaching 25.7% among those aged 14 to 24. For workers aged 25 to 29, the rate stood at 8.4%, while it declined steadily across older age groups, falling to 3.7% for those aged 35 to 44 and 2.3% for those aged 65 and over. Among employed workers, 8.8% were underemployed and 20.9% were not registered with social security in their main job. Meanwhile, Uruguay’s labor force participation rate stood at 64.4%, while the employment rate reached 59.5%.

【Iran says U.S. breached MoU on ending Lebanon hostilities, will set up oversight body】Iran’s deputy foreign minister and head of its technical negotiating delegation, Gharibabadi, told reporters after a tripartite meeting in Doha with Qatar and Pakistan that Tehran raised and reviewed alleged U.S. breaches of Article 1 of the Iran‑U.S. memorandum of understanding on ending hostilities in Lebanon. He said the delegation also discussed reports of increased U.S. regional military equipment and force deployments and what Iran described as threatening, interventionist U.S. rhetoric. Iran signaled the commitments in the MoU are indivisible and announced it will form a supervisory team to monitor, notify and review alleged violations via direct communication channels.

【UKMTO reports two vessel security incidents south of Balhaf, Yemen】UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported two security incidents in waters south of Balhaf, Yemen on July 1 local time. In the first, four armed individuals in a skiff approached and illegally boarded a merchant vessel, damaging the wheelhouse and accommodation; crew sheltered in the citadel and are reported safe. The skiff later left but remained in the area. In the second incident a skiff approached a tanker about 85 nm south of Balhaf before departing south; crew and vessel continued on their voyage. UKMTO said authorities are investigating and urged transiting vessels to increase vigilance and report suspicious activity.

European Stocks Drop from Records — European stocks eased from records on Wednesday as a fresh pullback for chip producers offset support from an improving macroeconomic backdrop. The Euro STOXX 50 dropped 0.6% to 5, and the STOXX Europe 600 fell 0.4% to 640. ASML and Infineon fell 4.6% each, tracking the AI infrastructure sector globally amid fresh uncertainty on whether the historical rally for chip producers has been overdone. Other companies with exposure to data centers and their power declined, with Siemens, Schneider, and Siemens Energy dropping between 3.1% and 1.5%. In turn, the software side rallied on respite from US hyperscaler giants. Also, banks were mostly higher as softer-than-expected inflation in the Eurozone limited expectations of another rate hike by the ECB this year. UniCredit added 0.6% and Deutsche Bank jumped 0.4%. The bloc's inflation rate fell to 2.8%, below expectations of 3%, and the core gauged fell to 2.4%.

【Pimco稱私募信貸市場存在“信任差距” 貸款質量成為評判標準】品浩(Pimco)指出，私募信貸投資者對估值差異問題日益敏感，從而在資產管理機構之間製造了一種“信任差距”。Pimco策略師Lotfi Karoui在本週公司官網釋出的一份報告中寫道，鑑於資產淨值越來越受各家機構自身假設的影響，那些貸款質量更高的管理機構日益獲得市場認可。他表示，市場不再對整個行業一概給予折價，而是在“管理機構、資產質量以及對報告估值的信任度方面，做出了更明確的區分”。監管機構當前正在加強對規模1.8萬億美元的私募信貸市場中估值差異問題的審查。紐約南區聯邦檢察官Jay Clayton曾對華爾街機構評估私募信貸資產價值的方式表達擔憂，這類資產通常不會頻繁交易。與此同時，包括阿波羅全球管理、阿瑞斯管理公司、貝萊德和黑石在內的一些大型私募信貸機構第二季度繼續面臨沉重的贖回壓力。

Russia Unemployment Rate Edges Down — The unemployment rate in Russia edged down to 2.1% in May 2026 from 2.2% in the previous month. The number of unemployed declined slightly to 1.6 million from 1.7 million, while the labour force edged up to 76.3 million from 76.2 million. 【Kevin Warsh: Fed balance-sheet reduction necessary but will not be rushed】Kevin Warsh said the Fed still needs to shrink its large balance sheet, but any major policy move will take time and be fully communicated. Decisions will undergo extensive public discussion and will not be implemented until financial markets fully understand the measures. He noted it took roughly 18 years to build the current balance sheet and that it now has fiscal-like attributes. Colombia Factory Activity Strengthens In June — Colombia’s Davivienda Manufacturing PMI rose to 53.7 in June 2026 from 51.8 in May, signaling the strongest improvement in factory conditions since November 2025. Stronger demand was the main driver, with new orders and total sales expanding at the fastest pace since last November. In response, manufacturers increased output and stepped up input purchases to meet rising production needs. Employment also rose for the third consecutive month, with the pace of hiring reaching a 17-month high. Firms reported growing order books despite passing on higher costs to customers, with output prices rising sharply and at a faster pace than in May. Input cost inflation eased to a three-month low but remained elevated, driven by higher labor, material, oil, and transportation costs. Looking ahead, business optimism improved on expectations of stronger marketing efforts, new product launches, better market conditions after the elections, and the signing of pending contracts.

Mexico Manufacturing PMI at 2024-Highs — The S&P Global Mexico Manufacturing PMI rose to 51.3 in June 2026 from 49.6 in May, marking the strongest reading since March 2024 and signaling improvement in operating conditions. Order book volumes expanded at the fastest pace in 27 months, supported by the FIFA World Cup, while new export orders rose at the end of the second quarter. Production declined marginally due to cash flow issues, input shortages, and technical stoppages. Input inventories fell for a ninth consecutive month as supplier delivery delays persisted, driven by blockades, highway insecurity, material shortages, customs issues, and the conflict in the Middle East. Meanwhile, buying activity rebounded, reflecting stronger demand and inventory building. On the labor market, manufactures singaled another job shedding. Meanwhile, cost pressures eased.Looking ahead, manufacturers remained optimistic, with business confidence rising to a three-month high.

Sugar Futures at Over 1-Month High — Sugar futures in the US extended their upward trend to around 14.9 US cents, reaching the highest since May 19, amid mounting weather concerns. An unusually strong El Niño event, a climate pattern associated with drier conditions in Asia-Pacific and increased rainfall in parts of the Americas, is posing risks to crops in major producing countries. Thailand is experiencing excessive dry conditions and India is expected to see below-normal July rainfall after its driest June in 12 years. Experts warned that weaker monsoon rainfall could reduce India’s annual sugar production by an estimated 3 million to 8 million tonnes. The government has already extended its sugar export ban until September 30. Meanwhile, output in Brazil's key center-south region fell 25.6% year-on-year to 2.2 million metric tons in the second half of May, while the volume of sugarcane processed was 13% smaller at 41.5 million tons, affected by rainfall that interrupted harvesting in some regions.

【歐洲央行管委Kaasik稱再加息一次是合理預期】歐洲央行管委UloKaasik表示，在伊朗戰爭之後可能需要進一步加息以確保通脹回到目標水平。“市場預計將再次加息，”這位愛沙尼亞央行行長在葡萄牙辛特拉表示。“目前看來，我認為至少再加息一次似乎是合理的。而且普遍認為，考慮到我們經歷的那種油價衝擊，需要這樣做來確保通脹降至2%。”在美國與伊朗和平談判推動能源價格下跌後，歐元區上月通脹放緩幅度超過預期。儘管如此，局勢仍然充滿波動，歐洲央行決策者正密切關注持續數月的大宗商品市場波動將如何傳導至整體經濟。部分出席歐洲央行年度論壇的歐洲央行官員表示，只要整體環境保持平穩，7月的會議可能維持借貸成本不變。“一個問題是地緣政治局勢將如何演變，以及石油市場會是什麼樣子，”Kaasik在談及7月22日至23日的會議時表示。“另一方面是持續三個月的油價衝擊將對其他價格產生什麼影響。”

【LME weighing rule easing to boost Hong Kong as metal warehousing hub】Four industry sources said the LME is considering loosening rules to enhance Hong Kong's role as a metal warehousing hub. Two sources said HKEx executives have queried warehousing firms on what barriers must be removed to make Hong Kong viable. In a March consultation the LME proposed allowing outdoor storage of aluminium on a location-by-location basis; sources said the proposal chiefly targets Hong Kong given limited indoor space. The LME briefly permitted outdoor aluminium storage in the mid-1990s but withdrew the option over weather damage and security concerns.

【歐洲央行行長稱通脹和增長風險有所緩和 當前局勢變化非常迅速】歐洲央行行長拉加德表示，歐元區通脹和增長面臨的風險已有所緩和。週三，在葡萄牙辛特拉舉行的歐洲央行年度論壇上，拉加德表示：“相比幾周前，我認為現在通脹的上行風險與增長的下行風險已大體更加平衡，原因是我們目前觀察到的情況，而且這些變化發生得非常迅速。”拉加德與美聯儲主席凱文·沃什、英國央行行長安德魯·貝利及加拿大央行行長Tiff Macklem一同出席了小組討論。就在三週前，歐洲央行成為伊朗戰爭爆發後七國集團(G7)中首個加息的央行。歐洲央行當時解釋稱，加息決定是基於對能源衝擊波及整個經濟的判斷，而且該行不能容忍通脹失控。自那次會議以來，貨幣政策領域已發生了許多變化。美伊和平談判導致石油價格大幅回落，消除了通脹的主要驅動因素。週三公佈的最新資料顯示，歐元區物價增長放緩幅度超過預期。“我們正在採取一切正確行動以確保物價穩定，”拉加德表示，“我們不會讓精靈跳出瓶子，任由通脹攀升。我們將採取必要行動，而且我們已經採取了。”

【美聯儲主席國際場合首秀釋放訊號 沃什稱將全力確保物價穩定】當地時間1日下午，美聯儲主席凱文·沃什出席歐洲央行在葡萄牙辛特拉舉辦的中央銀行論壇一場名為“貨幣政策”小組對話的議程，這是沃什自美聯儲6月議息會議出席新聞釋出會後，首次在國際場合公開發言。 對話期間，沃什與歐洲央行行長拉加德、英國央行行長貝利以及加拿大央行行長麥克勒姆就促進經濟增長、穩定就業、AI投資熱潮對通脹以及貨幣政策的潛在影響等話題進行了交流。沃什在對話中多次提及，美聯儲工作的優先事項是確保物價穩定。沃什稱，“如果有任何家庭、商業機構或者金融機構認為，美聯儲將容忍通脹率高於2%的長期目標，那麼這些人將來一定會失望”。沃什還強調，美聯儲將繼續保持獨立性，而不是服務於總統的政治主張。 上述四位央行行長還在對話中表示，面對複雜的全球經濟形勢，他們不會提供貨幣政策前瞻指引。對話舉行期間，市場繼續從“鷹派”角度解讀沃什的發言，大多數期限美債收益率走高，10年期美債收益率上漲約5個基點，逼近4.5%；30年期美債收益率上漲近7個基點，逼近5%關口。 （央視財經）

【US manufacturing expansion slows in June; input-cost gauge eases】June ISM manufacturing index fell 0.7 points to 53.3, marking a sixth consecutive month of expansion and remaining near a four‑year high; readings above 50 indicate expansion. Albania Holds Policy Rate — The Bank of Albania kept its key policy rate unchanged at 2.5% at its June 2026 meeting, maintaining that the current stance supports inflation's return to target. The overnight deposit and overnight lending rates also remained unchanged at 1.5% and 3.5%, respectively. Headline inflation averaged 2.9% in April-May, mainly driven by higher fuel prices, with supply-side pressures also affecting unprocessed food and services. Meanwhile, the economy expanded 3.7% year-on-year in the first quarter of 2026, supported by services and construction, with indicators pointing to continued growth in the first half of the year. The Bank expects inflation to rise further in the near term due to supply shocks before gradually easing over the medium term, while economic growth is projected to remain solid. Future policy decisions will remain focused on preserving price stability and containing persistent inflationary pressures.

【歐洲央行官員卡西克：市場合理預期央行將再加息一次】歐洲央行管理委員會成員卡西克表示，受伊朗衝突影響，或需進一步收緊貨幣政策，以確保通脹回落至目標水平。這位愛沙尼亞央行行長在葡萄牙辛特拉發言稱：“市場普遍預期央行將再度加息。目前來看，至少再加息一次是合理的。考慮到我們遭遇的石油衝擊，採取這一舉措才能保障通脹降至 2%，這點已形成普遍共識。”談及 7 月 22 日至 23 日的政策會議，卡西克表示：“一方面要看地緣局勢後續走向以及原油市場走勢；另一方面，持續三個月的油價衝擊會對各類商品物價產生多大影響，也有待觀察。”他還提出，需要開展更深入的分析，釐清大宗商品價格的變動邏輯。“部分能源基礎設施遭到損毀，多條供應鏈尚未恢復，因此衝擊大機率會產生長期影響。” 他說道，“當然也存在樂觀情景：和平協議順利落地、伊朗原油重返市場，油價大幅回落。但在我看來，通脹上行風險更大，不過我們仍需保持客觀審慎的判斷。”政策制定者密切關注的另一大隱患是：歐元區通脹上行是否會倒逼薪資持續上漲，進而固化物價上漲壓力，使其長期難以消退。“這是我最擔憂的風險。” 卡西克稱，“倘若局勢趨於穩定，今年秋季我們就能掌握更清晰的薪資資料，但恐怕眼下我們面臨的衝擊不止油價這一項。”

【英國央行行長貝利警告：現在考慮降息為時過早，英國家庭尚未完全感受到伊朗戰爭帶來的影響】英國央行行長貝利警告稱，現在考慮降息為時過早，英國家庭尚未完全感受到伊朗戰爭帶來的影響。貝利週三在葡萄牙辛特拉的會議上表示，儘管能源市場大幅回落令通脹風險有所緩解，但“降息不在目前考慮範圍內”。他指出，由於英國實行能源價格上限機制，戰爭對通脹的影響將出現“滯後反應”。英國規定能源供應商向居民收取天然氣和電力費用的最高單價，上限每三個月調整一次。受此前批發能源價格上漲影響，該價格上限於週三上調13%。英國央行行長安德魯·貝利貝利在歐洲央行年度論壇上借用足球作比喻稱：“現在借用一句足球術語很合適：恐怕我們總是上半場表現更好，下半場就沒那麼好了。”近幾個月來，貝利整體立場偏向鴿派。他傾向於採取觀望態度，以評估是否需要加息應對伊朗戰爭引發的通脹衝擊。隨著美國和伊朗達成停火協議後能源價格大幅回落，通脹風險迅速消退，貝利的策略似乎取得了成效。經濟學家目前預計，英國通脹峰值將明顯低於央行4月預測的水平。交易員也大幅削減了對英國央行加息的押注，目前市場定價顯示，今年累計加息幅度不足25個基點。不過，貝利仍對恢復降息的預期潑了冷水。他說：“市場曾預期我們今年會降息，考慮到經濟正在放緩，這樣的預期並非沒有道理。但3月份時降息就已不在考慮範圍內，現在也同樣如此”。

US Crude Oil Inventories Fall Less than Expected — US crude oil inventories fell by 3.775 million barrels to 408.3 million barrels in the week ended June 26, less than market expectations for a 5.1 million-barrel draw. Crude stocks at the Cushing, Oklahoma, delivery hub rose by 709 thousand barrels, the first increase after nine consecutive weeks of declines. Refinery crude runs rose by 85,000 barrels per day, while refinery utilization rates increased by 0.6 percentage points. Gasoline stocks fell by 2.333 million barrels to 214 million barrels, versus expectations for a 0.95 million-barrel draw. On the other hand, distillate stockpiles, which include diesel and heating oil, rose by 2.483 million barrels to 108.6 million barrels, compared with forecasts for a 0.7 million-barrel drop. Net US crude imports rose by 370,000 bpd.

US Dollar Index Eases from 15-Month High — The US dollar index rose to 101.3 on Wednesday, easing from the 15-month high of 101.6 earlier in the session after Fed Chairman Warsh said that inflationary risks are lower. The remark was aligned with a reduction in the ISM Manufacturing prices gauge, aided by the pullback in energy prices, and taming the risk of multiple Fed rate hikes this year Still, a majority of the market continued to expect some level of tightening. Data aggregated by the ADP indicated that the US private sector added nearly 100,000 jobs in June, slightly under market expectations but firmly above the average this year to maintain leeway for the Fed to restrict monetary policy. The dollar was also supported by Warsh's campaign to reduce the central bank's balance sheet, limiting the supply of dollars and playing a part in the unwinding of the dollar debasement trade from earlier in the year. Lastly, bets of ECB hikes eased amid softer inflation in the bloc, while a fiscally-dovish Japan pressured the yen.

Warsh Sees Easing Inflation Risks, Sticks to 2% Target Goal — Inflation risks have eased in recent weeks, but the US central bank remains committed to restoring inflation to its 2% target, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at the ECB’s Sintra Forum. Warsh stressed that delivering price stability remains the Fed's primary objective, while underscoring policymakers' independence in setting monetary policy and rejecting any suggestion that political pressure would influence their decisions. The Fed chief reiterated that the central bank will no longer provide traditional forward guidance on future interest-rate decisions, signaling a shift in its communication approach. 【Key takeaways from Fed, ECB, BoE and BOC chiefs】Fed chair KEVIN WARSH said the labour market is stable and demand remains strong; he declined to say whether the Fed will hike in July, saying the move will be fully debated. He prefers a smaller Fed balance sheet, will chart a new policy path, reaffirmed no short-term forward guidance but will keep the dot plot, and noted inflation expectations and risks have eased in recent weeks while committing to return inflation to 2%. Possible working-group head appointments next week; aims for real‑time data–driven policy within a year. AI is driving a capex surge and stronger demand, but its inflationary impact is still unclear. Bank of England governor BAILEY said energy prices have fallen, forward guidance becomes problematic over time, and activity and the labour market are slowing with an expanding output gap. He wants to remove interest‑rate risk from the BoE balance sheet, sees no case for cuts now and says policy has tightened even without further hikes. ECB president LAGARDE said Europe is not in stagflation, noted EU–US interdependence on AI, expressed regret about past constraints from forward guidance, and judged euro‑area inflation and growth risks more balanced than a few weeks ago. Bank of Canada governor MACKLEM said the Canadian economy is weak, equities look richly valued, and inflation remains clearly above target; the BoC will keep inflation expectations anchored. The BoC’s balance sheet is at a new steady state. The timing of any AI‑driven disinflation is uncertain and short‑term computer prices have risen. Policy sits near the lower bound of neutral and is roughly at a level to curb inflation; officials stand ready to act if conditions change.

Silver Jumps 3% on Fed Warsh’s Stance — Silver climbed 3% to $60 per ounce on Wednesday, rebounding from a seven-month low as investors weighed remarks from new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh while renewed US-Iran tensions fueled concerns over stability in the Middle East. Speaking at the ECB’s annual forum in Sintra, Portugal, Warsh said inflation risks and expectations had moderated in recent weeks but reaffirmed the Federal Reserve’s commitment to bringing inflation back to its 2% target. He also confirmed the Fed’s decision to move away from traditional forward guidance on interest rates, signaling a shift in the central bank’s communication strategy. Despite the change in communication, investors continued to price in further US interest-rate hikes this year as policymakers seek to contain inflation against the backdrop of a resilient labor market. Meanwhile, markets closely followed developments in US-Iran peace talks in Qatar, although direct negotiations between the two countries remained unlikely.

10-Year Yields Trim Rebound — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note eased to 4.47% after testing 4.5% earlier in the session after Fed Chairman Warsh said inflation risks in the US were softening. This was aligned with the softer price data from the ISM PMI, as wholesale energy prices returned to levels comparable from before the war in the Middle East. Still, yields held 10bps above the seven-week low from Monday. The ADP Report showed 100,000 private-sector jobs were added to the economy, adding leeway for the Fed to tighten monetary policy to combat high inflation. Although oil prices retreated, refined fuel costs remained sharply higher and backed expectations of a Fed hike this year. Rate traders still showed a loose consensus of one hike by December, but a portion of the market has priced multiple hikes. In the meantime, Warsh reiterated his view that the Fed's balance sheet is too high and hampers the transmission of monetary policy through rate-setting, potentially preluding selling of notes and bonds.

US Construction Spending Edges Up 0.1% — Construction spending in the US edged up 0.1% month-over-month to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of $2,210.2 billion in May 2026, following a downwardly revised 0.3% rise in April and compared to forecasts of a 0.2% gain. Residential spending went up 0.4% while nonresidential flattened. Out of nonresidential construction spending, declines were seen in manufacturing (-1.4%), power (-0.2%) and commercial (-0.3%), offsetting gains in office (0.2%), educational (0.3%) and highway and street (0.6%). During the first five months of this year, construction spending amounted to $858.4 billion, up 2.7%.

US Manufacturing Sector Growth Cools in June — The ISM Manufacturing PMI for the US fell to 53.3 in June 2026, down from 54.0 in May and below market expectations of 54. The latest reading indicated a slowdown in the manufacturing sector, as both output (52.2 vs. 54.3 in May) and new orders (56.0 vs. 56.8) grew at a slower pace. Employment remained in contraction territory, although the pace of job losses eased, with the employment index rising to 49.7 from 48.6. Meanwhile, the prices index declined sharply to 73.0 from 82.1, indicating some easing in cost pressures, though price growth remained elevated. Survey respondents continued to cite concerns over moderating but still high inflation, driven in part by the conflict in the Middle East. They also pointed to the risk of higher interest rates and ongoing policy uncertainty, particularly surrounding tariffs and global trade, as key headwinds for the manufacturing sector.

Gold Jumps 2% on Warsh’s Remarks — Gold prices surged 2% to $4,090 per ounce on Wednesday, rebounding from near eight-month lows, as investors parsed comments from new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh and fresh US-Iran tensions raised doubts about Middle East stability. Speaking at the ECB’s annual forum in Sintra, Portugal, Warsh acknowledged that inflation risks and expectations have eased in recent weeks but reaffirmed the Fed’s commitment to returning inflation to its 2% target. He emphasized the central bank’s focus on price stability, a stance he first outlined in his debut press conference last month. Warsh also reiterated his decision to abandon traditional "forward guidance" on interest-rate policy, marking a shift in the Fed’s communication approach. Despite this, investors continued to bet on US rate hikes this year to curb inflation amid a robust labor market. Meanwhile, markets monitored updates from US-Iran peace talks in Qatar, though direct negotiations between the two sides remained unlikely.

【US June manufacturing output and orders further improve】S&P Global's final June manufacturing PMI showed output and order growth further improved, continuing the expansion seen since the Middle East conflict began, S&P Global chief business economist Chris Williamson said. US Manufacturing PMI Revised Down in June — The S&P Global US Manufacturing PMI was sharply revised down to 53.9 in June 2026, significantly below the preliminary estimate of 55.7 and May’s final reading of 55.1. Despite the drop, the latest figure marked the eleventh straight month of expansion, indicating a solid improvement in operating conditions, though the weakest in three months. Output and new orders continued to rise, albeit at slower yet historically strong rates, driven by new product launches and pre-orders to hedge against rising prices. Input costs increased sharply due to higher raw material prices, though the rise was softer than May’s peak. Selling price inflation also eased to a three-month low. However, job cuts accelerated to the fastest pace since May 2020, the quickest outside the pandemic since October 2009. Business optimism for the year ahead also declined for the second consecutive month, hitting its lowest level since October 2025.

Euro Slides as Inflation Eases and Dollar Strengthens — The euro weakened below $1.14, approaching a one-year low after a 2% decline against the US dollar in June. Investors digested softer-than-expected Eurozone inflation data, with the flash CPI report showing headline inflation falling to 2.8% in June and the core rate dropping to 2.4%, offering some relief to European Central Bank policymakers. At the ECB’s Sintra Forum, ECB President Christine Lagarde noted that risks to inflation and growth in the euro area have become less pronounced. This shift follows the ECB’s decision just three weeks earlier to become the first G7 central bank to raise interest rates after the outbreak of the Iran war, justified by concerns over inflation spreading through the economy. Since then, the US-Iran peace accord has significantly reduced oil prices, removing a key inflation driver. Elsewhere, the dollar remains supported by expectations that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates later this year.

【Beijing targets global scientific-intelligence innovation hub by 2028】Beijing's municipal science commission and the Zhongguancun administrative committee issued an Implementation Plan (2026–2028) to accelerate AI-enabled scientific research, targeting a global scientific-intelligence innovation hub by 2028 to support the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei international science and technology innovation centre. Brazil Manufacturing PMI Returns to Growth — The S&P Global Brazil Manufacturing PMI rose to 50.8 in June 2026 from 49.1 in May, signaling a renewed improvement in factory conditions. The rebound was driven by stronger hiring, stock accumulation, and longer supplier delivery times. However, output and new orders remained in contraction territory, indicating that underlying demand stayed weak. The Suppliers’ Delivery Times Index also contributed to the headline increase, although longer delivery times were linked to supply-chain disruptions stemming from the Middle East conflict rather than stronger demand. Contractions in production and total new orders softened from May, but all three broad manufacturing segments still reported declines in output, orders, and external sales. 【歐盟機構：6月單日全球海面溫度破歷史同期紀錄】歐盟氣候監測機構哥白尼氣候變化服務局和“哥白尼海洋服務”計劃7月1日聯合釋出公報說，6月21日當天全球海洋表面平均溫度打破歷史同期紀錄。 哥白尼氣候變化服務局資料顯示，6月21日當天的全球海洋表面平均溫度升至20.86攝氏度，高於2023年和2024年同期的20.83攝氏度。“哥白尼海洋服務”計劃的資料顯示，同日全球海洋表面平均溫度達21攝氏度，比2023年和2024年創下的紀錄高出0.1攝氏度。 公報說，這一新的海洋高溫紀錄與熱帶太平洋海域出現厄爾尼諾的形成條件有關。世界氣象組織6月2日釋出公報說，考慮到熱帶太平洋海水異常溫暖等因素，6月至8月出現厄爾尼諾事件的機率為80%，未來數月極端天氣出現風險隨之攀升。 哥白尼氣候變化服務局主任卡洛·布翁滕波說，當前狀況可能表明，未來幾個月很可能看到更多溫度紀錄被打破。 過去數月，全球多個海域都觀測到海洋表面異常高溫。公報警告，海洋表面高溫可能影響天氣模式，增加風暴、極端降水和洪澇風險，加劇海平面上升和冰雪融化，對海洋生態系統、漁業和沿海經濟等造成壓力。(新華社)

【BofA expects BOC to hold rates until 2027 even if Fed hikes】BofA says Macklem’s backdrop differs from peers: Canada’s core inflation is roughly 2% and energy-rich provinces have seen short-term gains from the oil-price surge, leaving little sign of overheating. After a small Q1 contraction, Q2 annualized growth is expected above 2%; traders have pulled back wagers on a year-end BOC hike. BofA now expects the Bank of Canada to keep policy rates unchanged until 2027 even if the Fed resumes tightening.

【UK inflation near peak — will Bailey pave way for cuts at Sintra?】Bank of England Governor Bailey is scheduled to speak in Sintra this week and is expected to take a relatively relaxed tone. A global oil-price plunge has eased inflation pressures; institutional research projects inflation will peak near 3% and fall to about 2.3% next year, well below the BoE’s prior outlook, which could allow rates to be cut from 3.75% to 3.5% by June 2027. Markets will watch whether Bailey today effectively endorses that view and explicitly rules out further hikes.

【Kevin Warsh's two-faced strategy: hawkish rhetoric to placate rate-hike camp, delay tactics in practice】Analyst Andrew Sacher said Kevin Warsh's June FOMC debut left markets debating whether he is hawkish or dovish. With the FOMC split on hiking versus holding rates, Warsh's stance is pivotal; the Sintra meeting will be a fresh opportunity to reassess. Sacher views Warsh primarily as a politician who tailors comments to both wings—rhetoric may tilt hawkish, stressing price stability to reassure members favoring hikes as a signal of Fed independence from Trump. His actions, notably creating five working groups to review key Fed issues, have bought time and delayed near-term policy moves.

US 10-Year Yield Extends Rebound — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note rose toward 4.50% on Wednesday, extending the sharp rebound since dropping to a seven-week low of 4.36% on Monday amid the hawkish outlook for the Federal Reserve. Fresh data from the ADP indicated the US added nearly 100,000 private-sector jobs in June, slightly under estimates but extending the period of low firing in most sectors of the economy. The robust data combined with evidence of elevated core inflation rates following the interruption of global oil supply with the war in the Middle East. Although wholesale oil prices eased to pre-war levels, refined fuel costs remained sharply higher and backed expectations of a Fed hike this year. Rate traders still showed a loose consensus of one hike by December, but a portion of the market has priced multiple hikes. In the meantime, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh campaign to shrink the Fed's holdings of Treasury notes and bonds also lifted yields.

Chile Economic Activity Contracts Again — Chile's IMACEC economic activity index fell 0.9% year-on-year in May 2026, marking the fifth consecutive month of contraction, though less sharply than the 1.2% decline recorded in April. Goods production contracted 4.7%, reflecting a sharp drop in mining output (-11.6%), particularly copper, alongside a 1.7% decline in manufacturing, while production of other goods was unchanged. Meanwhile, services activity grew 1.0%, supported by stronger personal services, especially health and education, which partly offset weaker business and transport services. Trade increased 0.8%, driven mainly by retail and automotive sales. On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, economic activity edged down 0.2% in May, reserving a 0.1% increase in the previous month.

【ST中裝：股票交易異常波動 申請撤銷警示尚待稽核】ST中裝公告稱，公司股票於2026年6月29日、6月30日、7月1日連續三個交易日收盤價格漲跌幅偏離值累計超12%，屬異常波動。公司已向深交所申請撤銷其他風險警示，尚需稽核，結果不確定。目前公司經營及內外部環境未變，未發現重大影響的報道及傳聞，無應披露未披露事項，異常波動期間控股股東及實控人無買賣公司股票行為。公司計劃8月28日披露半年報。

【美國股指期貨交投氣氛謹慎 交易員等待沃什講話指引】7月伊始，股市交投氣氛謹慎，交易員等待美聯儲主席凱文·沃什的講話。眼下，市場對美國加息的押注正在升溫。美元和債券收益率走高。紐約時間8:03，標普500指數期貨和道指期貨下跌0.3%，納斯達克100指數期貨跌0.6%。貨幣市場目前計入美聯儲下次政策會議加息的機率約為三分之一。ING Bank NV外匯策略師Chris Turner寫道：“鑑於美聯儲當前沒有提供前瞻指引，市場將高度關注沃什的表態。如果聚焦價格穩定，就可能繼續支撐美元。”

【中創環保：選舉孫成宇為董事長 原董事長因刑案辭職】中創環保公告稱，董事長張紅亮因涉嫌刑事犯罪被刑拘，申請辭去相關職務。6月29日，公司召開第六屆董事會第二十次會議，選舉孫成宇為董事長、第六屆董事會各專門委員會委員，戰略委員會由其擔任主任委員，任期至第六屆董事會屆滿。公司將盡快完成工商變更登記及6個月內完成董事會秘書聘任工作。孫成宇曾任公司審計部門等負責人，目前未持股，無關聯關係及違規情形。

【多家MLCC廠商稱“正醞釀漲價”，業內看漲至2027年年底】有媒體報道，市場傳出，被動元件公司國巨通知客戶，今日起上調全系列電容產品報價，涵蓋積層陶瓷電容（MLCC）、鋁電解電容、鉭質電容、高分子鋁電容、薄膜電容及超級電容等，是國巨近年來調漲範圍最大的一波。此前，村田、三星電機、太陽誘電等海外MLCC大廠釋出調價通知，AI伺服器用的高容MLCC漲價幅度區間普遍達到15%～35%，部分稀缺型號現貨市場報價實現翻倍上漲。同日，記者在慕尼黑上海電子展上瞭解到，多家MLCC廠商已在醞釀下半年漲價。

【美國企業6月份新增9.8萬個工作崗位 表現穩健但低於預期】6月份美國私營部門就業崗位增長依然穩健，進一步表明今年勞動力市場已趨於穩定。根據ADP Research週三釋出的資料，私營部門就業人數在前一個月增加12.2萬後，於6月增加了9.8萬。對經濟學家的調查顯示，市場預期中值為增加12萬。
【晶科能源簽約義大利200.3MW飛虎3地面電站訂單】近日，晶科能源與義大利清潔能源投資商正式簽署200.3MW高效元件供貨協議，全部採用飛虎3（Tiger Neo 3.0）N型TOPCon高效雙面元件，專項用於義大利南部大型地面電站建設。

【2028年1月起，PlayStation新遊戲將不再推出實體光碟版本】PlayStation當地時間7月1日釋出宣告稱，2028年1月起，所有在PlayStation主機上發售的新遊戲將不再推出實體光碟版本，將僅以數字版形式在PlayStation商店和零售商處發售。此次調整不會影響此前已發售或將在2028年1月前以光碟形式發售的遊戲。

【渤海租賃：控股子公司擬97.19億元購買11架A321NEO訂單飛機資產】渤海租賃公告稱，2026年6月30日（都柏林時間），公司控股子公司Avolon下屬子公司與Frontier簽署協議，購買11架A321NEO訂單飛機資產。以空客公司2018年目錄價格，飛機資產目錄價約14.25億美元，摺合人民幣約97.19億元，實際購買價以協議為準，飛機預計2026年11月至2027年6月交付。該交易不構成關聯交易、重大資產重組及借殼，已獲公司董事會審議透過，無需股東會審議及有關部門批准。
【華為與西北政法大學簽署合作協議】近日，華為技術有限公司（簡稱“華為”）與西北政法大學在深圳正式簽署合作協議，並開展人才培養與產教融合座談會。雙方將圍繞ICT人才培養、聯合創新、人工智慧和智慧校園四個方向開展深度合作，致力於推進學校教學、科研數字化改革，深化“人工智慧+法學”交叉學科複合型人才聯合培育，探索全域協同數智校園新模式，助力高等教育數智化轉型。

【特斯拉6月份在歐洲的註冊量攀升】週三公佈的資料顯示，特斯拉在多個歐洲市場的註冊量6月份出現增長，這家美國電動汽車製造商在釋出第二季度交付報告前，其歐洲地區銷量延續了復甦勢頭。據bilstatistik.dk、MobilitySweden和ANFAC資料顯示，作為銷量指標的特斯拉註冊量在丹麥增長了39%，在瑞典增長了56%，在西班牙增長了5.6%。據汽車行業組織PFA稱，在法國註冊量增長了一倍多。法國一直是特斯拉的亮點市場。ING Research高階經濟學家裡科·盧曼表示，該國的電動汽車補貼計劃以及企業車隊電動化程序的加快，推動了當地需求增長；與此同時，特斯拉也正在從去年圍繞馬斯克的爭議中恢復過來。

【Sources: OPEC+ may again raise August oil output target】Three sources said on Wednesday that OPEC+ producers are set to agree at Sunday’s meeting to raise August output targets by about 188,000 bpd, matching the increases in June and July. The move would add supply as the Strait of Hormuz gradually reopens and oil prices slide. OPEC declined to comment.
【日本巖手縣近海發生6.0級地震】據CCTV國際時訊，日本氣象廳訊息，當地時間今天（7月1日）21時08分左右，北京時間20時08分左右，日本巖手縣附近海域發生6.0級地震，最大震感為“震度4”，震源深度40公里。無引發海嘯風險。
【首爾警方調查韓國隊主帥任命是否違法】韓國國家足球隊在2026年美加墨世界盃小組賽階段遭淘汰後，韓國國內質疑洪明甫被任命為國家隊主教練的聲音再起。首爾警方1日就這一任命過程中是否存在違法行為啟動調查。（新華社）

【6.0 magnitude earthquake offshore Iwate, Japan】Japan Meteorological Agency said a magnitude-6.0 earthquake struck offshore Iwate Prefecture at about 21:08 JST on July 1 (20:08 Beijing time). Maximum seismic intensity was shindo 4 and focal depth 40 km. JMA reported no tsunami risk.

【US private sector payrolls +98,000 in June; growth uneven】ADP reported US private payrolls rose 98,000 in June; private-sector wages were up 4.4% YoY. Employment gains were uneven: financial activities and information led growth, while leisure and hospitality hiring was weak for a sixth consecutive month. ADP chief economist Nela Richardson said, "The pace of hiring reflects both supply and demand. We know it is taking longer for people to find jobs, but some sectors show signs of labor supply tightness. For now, the net effect is slower employment growth."

【ADP：美國6月份的就業增長呈現不均衡態勢】ADP首席經濟學家Nela Richardson：招聘步伐正在呈現一個關於供給與需求的雙重敘事。人們找到工作的時間正在變長，但在某些行業也出現了勞動力供給受限的跡象。目前總體影響是就業創造正在放緩。ADP報告顯示：私營僱主在6月份新增了9.8萬個就業崗位。6月份的就業增長呈現不均衡態勢，金融和資訊行業是新增崗位的主要來源，而休閒和酒店業則連續第六個月出現招聘疲軟。6月份，留職員工的薪資增長保持穩定，中位薪資增幅為4.4%；而換工作員工的同比增長率則加速至6.6%。

Mexico Manufacturing Confidence Improves in June — Business confidence in Mexico’s manufacturing sector rose by 0.5 points to 48.0 in June 2026 from May, improving modestly but remaining below the 50-point threshold for the 16th consecutive month. The assessment of the country’s current economic situation increased 0.5 points to 48.1, while expectations for the country’s future economic outlook rose 0.4 points to 51.8. The “right time to invest” component posted the strongest gain, climbing 2.3 points to 34.5. 【最新文獻揭露AI時代華爾街同質化風險 同類模型氾濫令阿爾法加速衰減】從對沖基金到財富管理機構，華爾街正在擁抱人工智慧(AI)，期望藉此取得投資優勢。如今，研究人員開始追問，當越來越多投資者轉向類似的AI模型來尋找這種優勢時，會發生什麼：他們會買入相同的股票，對相同的頭條訊息作出反應，有時還會犯下相同的錯誤。新近研究顯示，這種情形可能對整個市場產生影響。人工智慧或許會讓投資者行動更快、掌握更多資訊，但也可能讓他們的交易更趨擁擠、系統更容易被欺騙，風險承擔也更難控制。近期多項研究表明，隨著投資者趨同於相同機會，人工智慧的廣泛採用可能會縮短盈利性交易訊號的壽命。還有研究發現，AI模型系統性地承擔了超出預期的風險，或者會因其攝取的資訊而受到操縱。

【比特幣下跌，受美國加息押注及Strategy新計劃影響】比特幣在隔夜觸及21個月低點後依然承壓。對美聯儲可能加息的預期是導致該加密貨幣走弱的原因之一。Trade Nation的David Morrison在一份報告中表示，囤積加密貨幣的公司Strategy可能出售比特幣以籌集更多現金的訊息，也無助於提振市場情緒。“這是該公司創始人Michael Saylor曾說過永遠不會發生的事情。”他表示，投資者似乎正在撤出加密貨幣，並湧入半導體股票以及任何與AI相關的領域。

【Nomura: Too early to call peak in chip stocks】Nomura analysts say it is too early to declare chip stocks have peaked and expect the sector’s upward momentum to continue. They cite two drivers: hyperscale data‑center operators that must scale or exit are unlikely to stop investing through 2027, in part because rising storage‑chip costs are sustaining spend; and data‑center buildouts are accelerating. The team calls the recent chip‑price pullback “healthy” but warns markets have not yet priced some potential future risks and supply shortages.

【思特威新一代高速光互連方案亮相慕尼黑上海電子展，有望2027年商用落地】在今日舉行的慕尼黑上海電子展上，思特威新一代高速光互連方案首次亮相。該方案利用MicroLED作為光源替代傳統鐳射器，可將光電轉換效率提升30%。現場展示的資料顯示，MicroLED單通道傳輸速率已突破3Gbps，典型功耗低至0.8pJ/bit。思特威高速光互聯BG聯席總經理王文軒表示，MicroLED高速光互連方案有望在2027年商用落地。

【中國—越南跨境經濟合作區建設磋商推進工作組第一次會議在廣西南寧召開】6月29日，商務部副部長兼國際貿易談判副代表凌激與越南工貿部副部長潘氏勝在廣西南寧共同召開中國—越南跨境經濟合作區建設磋商推進工作組第一次會議。凌激表示，建設中越跨境經濟合作區是兩黨兩國最高領導人達成的重要共識，也是構建更高水平具有戰略意義的中越命運共同體的務實舉措。中越兩國產供鏈深度融合，貿易投資合作日益緊密，為加快推進跨境經濟合作區建設創造良好基礎。雙方工作組開展了專業深入、卓有成效的討論，就建設跨境經濟合作區政府間協議框架要素、建立三級聯動工作機制等事項達成基本共識。雙方要充分發揮磋商推進工作組機制統籌協調作用，從中央和地方層面抓緊開展後續工作，加強規劃協同、政策協同、建設協同、招商協同，以高質量建設跨境經濟合作區不斷深化中越經貿合作，實現優勢互補、互利共贏。

【檔案顯示：特朗普 2025 年從嘉信理財獲得超 5000 萬美元貸款】根據特朗普向美國政府道德辦公室提交的 2025 年度財產披露檔案，美國總統唐納德・特朗普去年從嘉信理財銀行獲得一筆超過 5000 萬美元的貸款。特朗普在該行持有資產質押信貸額度，這類信貸產品允許借款人以名下投資資產作質押提取現金；但他 2024 年的道德申報檔案中並未披露該筆授信。週二公佈的 2025 年披露檔案顯示，該信貸額度利率為 3.9%，檔案未寫明具體貸款金額與資金用途。
